cause: The pack-target code fails on Python 2.7 only: the generated target __init__ is treated as an unbound method of _PackTargetMethods. A typo (isinstane) was also found in pack_target.py.
fix: Use Python 3, where the error does not occur (the maintainer recommends 3.7), and correct the isinstane typo in pack_target.py by hand; the maintainer said he would fix it quickly.

message: usb.core.USBError: [Errno 16] Resource busy
title: pyOCD: Flashing two boards at the same time on Linux fails with USB Resource busy
cause: pyOCD lacked support for simultaneous access to several devices, so a second instance failed with 'Resource busy' when claiming a USB interface while enumerating the boards.
fix: Use a pyOCD version containing PR #268, which adds simultaneous device access; the reporter confirmed that two devices then worked concurrently.

message: SFD Code generation warning: Enumerated values list for field 'MYFIELD1' exeeds maximum of 256 elements. List will not be generated.
title: svdconv: SVDConv M227 says enumerated values exceed 256 elements for narrow fields
cause: The real limit for generating enumerated value lists in the SfrCC/MDK5 output is a field width of 6 bits (64 entries), chosen to keep the combo-box control usable; the M227 message wrongly named 256 entries.
fix: The M227 message was corrected to state the field width and the 6-bit limit (available in a CMSIS-Toolbox nightly). Unlisted values can be described with an enumeratedValue carrying isDefault true; SVDConv expands it for SfrCC/MDK5, while other tools can interpret it directly for fields wider than 6 bits.

title: cbuild: IAR object files get a double suffix (file.c.o) unlike the IAR IDE (file.o)
cause: Object file naming is left to CMake, whose IAR module sets .o as extension without replacing the source extension, so linker scripts that name objects like fsl_clock.o do not match.
fix: Proposed: enable CMAKE_C_OUTPUT_EXTENSION_REPLACE, CMAKE_CXX_... and CMAKE_ASM_OUTPUT_EXTENSION_REPLACE (set to 1) in IAR.<version>.cmake; the thread did not confirm the final release.

message: armclang: warning: argument unused during compilation: '-MD' |  '-MT' | '-MF' [-Wunused-command-line-argument]
title: cbuild: Legacy armasm sources produce unused-argument warnings for -MD/-MT/-MF
cause: Dependency-tracking flags added for all assembler files are not understood by the legacy armasm path.
fix: Harmless. No fix planned; migrate such files to GNU assembler syntax or the armclang integrated assembler.

title: CMSIS Solution: Software Components view stays empty after reopening VS Code
cause: Intermittent loading problem, often seen after installing a new extension version.
fix: Close and reopen the Software Components view; reported fixed in later CMSIS Solution builds.

title: CMSIS-View: Program fails before main with Event Recorder when heap size is 0 on AC6
cause: Event Recorder uses no heap. The heap-using C/C++ library functions (stdio, C++ library) require heap, and zero heap breaks startup; here the project implicitly used malloc/free through its library setup.
fix: Give the library a heap or avoid heap-using library functions per the Arm C library heap documentation.

title: other: ExecuTorch with Clang embedded toolchain lacks std::chrono::steady_clock and random_device
cause: The libc++ shipped with the Clang-based embedded toolchain has no monotonic clock or entropy source implementation for bare metal, so ExecuTorch code using them does not compile or link.
fix: Provide the missing pieces through stub implementations (the CMSIS-Executorch project ships a posix stub source for this) and use a Clang toolchain file equivalent to the GCC one. A temporary alternative in the thread was to take libstdc++ from a GCC installation.

title: pyOCD: pyocd on Raspberry Pi: DistributionNotFound for cmsis-pack-manager after --no-deps install
cause: pyocd's entry-point loading still requires cmsis-pack-manager, which has no prebuilt wheel for ARM and needs Rust to build, so the documented --no-deps route no longer works.
fix: Build and install cmsis-pack-manager from source on the device first (Rust toolchain and system packages needed), then install pyocd. Expect Rust-version build breakage; the non-x86 install document was outdated.

message: C Control block not found [__main__]
title: pyOCD: RTT 'Control block not found' after upgrading from 0.34.3 to 0.35
cause: The search compared a full 16-byte padded ID, so a block whose ID string is followed by non-zero bytes ('SEGGER RTT' is shorter than 16) was missed.
fix: Fix the search to match only the real ID length; a local fix worked and a maintainer asked for a pull request. Downgrading to 0.34.3 is a stop-gap.

message: Cannot access memory at address 0x3001c660
title: pyOCD: gdb 'Cannot access memory' when setting breakpoint on Realtek RTL8195AM SDRAM code
cause: Code lives in SDRAM at 0x3xxxxxxx, outside the hardware breakpoint range, so a software breakpoint is needed, and SDRAM is not accessible until the bootloader has initialised it after reset.
fix: Break early after boot first (for example at the platform start function), run to it, then set breakpoints in SDRAM code. Full target support was not available in pyocd.

message: DAP_CONNECT failed
title: pyOCD: Microchip nEDBG: 'DAP_CONNECT failed' with default protocol
cause: The nEDBG probe did not respond properly to the default port selection.
fix: Connect with -O dap_protocol=swd. The device identity (variant) selected may also matter for actual programming.

message: STLink, CMSIS-DAPv2 and PicoProbe probes are not supported because no libusb library was found.
title: pyOCD: pyOCD cannot find CMSIS-DAP v2 or ST-Link probes on Windows with Python 3.12 or 3.13
cause: The libusb DLL is not found by the USB backend in this Python and pyOCD combination, so all libusb based probe types are disabled. Copying libusb-1.0.dll next to python.exe or into system32 did not help.
fix: Workaround reported: put the folder holding libusb-1.0.dll on PATH from Python before the backend loads, e.g. os.environ['PATH'] = r'<libusb dll dir>' + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'] at the top of pyocd/probe/pydapaccess/interface/pyusb_v2_backend.py. Python 3.11 works without this.

title: cbuild: Assembly file with .S extension is not compiled with IAR and CMake 3.21
cause: CMake 3.21.x does not treat .S as an assembler source for the IAR toolchain; CMake 3.25 does.
fix: Use CMake 3.25 or newer (a bump of the minimum for IAR was suggested), and make sure the assembler source uses IAR syntax, since GNU-style assembler files do not build with the IAR assembler.

title: cbuild: Working directory of executes commands is the tmp folder
cause: The working directory of an execute run command is intentionally unspecified (it was the intermediate directory), so relative script paths break.
fix: List scripts as input and refer to them with access sequences: run: python $input(0)$ with input: $ProjectDir()$/scripts/script.py.

title: cbuild: .clangd points to out/ but compile_commands.json is in tmp/
cause: The compilation database is only copied to the output folder by the database target (cbuild setup), and the copy failed when the out folder structure did not exist yet.
fix: Run cbuild setup <solution> --context-set or a normal build first. A cbuild2cmake fix creates the folders. Do not edit tmp manually.

title: cbuild: No program size printed at the end of a GCC build
cause: The size line comes from linker options in cdefault.yml (armlink summary), and a local cdefault without them prints nothing; GCC needs its own option.
fix: Use the cdefault.yml shipped with toolbox 2.7 or newer, which adds -Wl,-print-memory-usage for GCC, or add that option yourself.

title: cbuild: Startup/linker files in RTE are not replaced after changing compiler in csolution.yml
cause: The tools never delete configuration files from the RTE folder. If a pack offers compiler-specific config files under the same component, the file names or extensions must differ per compiler; here the pack description did not do that.
fix: Fix the pack description so compiler variants have mutually exclusive file names. As a workaround delete the stale RTE files, switch the compiler and run Update RTE.

message: (1/1) Cleaning context: "Hello.Debug+CS300"
title: cbuild: cbuild cleans and rebuilds every time when CMSIS_COMPILER_ROOT is set and -c is used
cause: A change of the compiler registration root deliberately forces a rebuild, because generated CMake files from another toolbox installation may hold stale paths. With the context given by -c the check fired on every run.
fix: Build with --active (what the VS Code extension does) and the second run reports no work to do. The repeated clean was no longer seen in toolbox 2.14.1 nightlies.

message: error cbuild: error executing 'cbuildgen cmake'
title: cbuild: Database generation fails because the RTE folder does not exist yet
cause: The compile_commands.json generation ran before the RTE folder was populated. The warning itself says to use --update-rte; the extension must update RTE first.
fix: Run a build or touch the csolution.yml so cbuild runs with --update-rte (or csolution update-rte).

message: error cbuild: exit status 0xc0000409
title: cbuild: cbuild exits with status 0xc0000409 when run from Cygwin on Windows
cause: Cygwin versions of cmake and ninja combined with MDK-generated RTE files cause the crash. Cygwin is not a supported environment.
fix: Use the Windows installation of cmake and ninja or build from a native shell.

title: CMSIS-Core: "unknown type name IRQn_Type" when using only CMSIS-Core with a TI device
cause: CMSIS-Core does not define device interrupt numbers; the device header from the vendor DFP provides IRQn_Type and includes the core header.
fix: Use the device header and startup file from the DFP or SDK, or write a minimal one following the Cortex_DFP template.

title: CMSIS-Core: Telling Cortex-M33 and Cortex-M85 apart in the preprocessor
cause: Compilers do not agree on the architecture macros: GCC reports the same __ARM_ARCH and __ARM_ARCH_8M_MAIN__ values for both cores, other toolchains differ again, so the ACLE macros cannot reliably separate the two.
fix: Test the CMSIS core revision macro instead, for example #if defined (__CM85_REV) for a Cortex-M85. CMSIS provides a fallback value when the device header does not define the revision, so the macro exists for every device.

title: CMSIS-Core: NVIC_SystemReset on Cortex-M55 may return without resetting
cause: On M55 the SYSRESETREQ bit is cleared on entry to WARM_RST; if the power controller denies the transition, no reset happens and nobody sets the bit again. Arm errata 3776408.
fix: Re-assert AIRCR.SYSRESETREQ inside the wait loop of NVIC_SystemReset; maintainers asked for a PR with this change.

title: CMSIS-Core: __PROGRAM_START not found at link time when startup.c is compiled as C++
cause: Name mangling when a .c file is built in C++ mode.
fix: Build .c files as C; CMSIS does not support compiling them as C++ even with extern "C".

title: CMSIS-Core: ITM->LAR / LSR no longer compile after moving a Cortex-M33 project to CMSIS 6
cause: CMSIS 6 deliberately dropped the LAR and LSR lock registers from ITM_Type in core_cm33.h, because the common ARMv8-M ground does not require them. A vendor SDK that was written against CMSIS 5 and still touches ITM->LAR therefore fails to build.
fix: Take the register declaration from the device family pack of the vendor if it provides one, or declare it yourself in the project (for example write the unlock key 0xC5ACCE55 straight to the ITM lock address of your device). Check in the device manual that the part really implements the ITM lock mechanism before adding it.

title: CMSIS-Core: GCC linker script template shows RAM usage 100 percent
cause: The stack section in the template is placed at the end of RAM and counted as used by the linker report; the layout is intended.
fix: Accept the figure or make the stack NOLOAD, which loses the stack at the end of RAM and risks overflows into heap.

message: Error[Pe1866]: attribute does not apply to any entity
title: CMSIS-Core: IAR C++ compile of startup .c: attribute does not apply to any entity
cause: CMSIS expects .c files to be compiled as C; in C++ mode IAR maps __NO_RETURN to [[noreturn]], which is invalid inside an extern "C" declaration.
fix: Compile .c files in C mode.

title: CMSIS Debugger: Memory Inspector cannot load back a hex file dumped from addresses above 0x80000000
cause: The Memory Inspector mishandled addresses in the upper half of the 32-bit range when re-importing a dumped hex file; this was an upstream defect of the extension.
fix: Update Memory Inspector to 1.3.0 or later.

title: CMSIS Debugger: Memory Inspector cells do not re-render: no periodic update, no edit, no keyboard nav
cause: The Memory Inspector memoized cell and row data that did not change identity although the contents changed, so the view showed stale cells.
fix: Update the Memory Inspector extension to 1.3.0 or later, which contains the fix.

title: CMSIS Debugger: How to get Event Recorder output without a graphical viewer in VS Code
cause: The CMSIS Debugger extension has no graphical Event Recorder view yet.
fix: Select the component variant CMSIS-View:Event Recorder with Semihosting and build for semihosting; run the application with the debugger attached, which writes EventRecorder.log into the project directory. Decode that log with the eventlist utility from the CMSIS-View tools (shipped with the CMSIS-Toolbox).

title: CMSIS Debugger: XRTOS view stuck on "Loading" with Zephyr
cause: RTOS Views 0.0.12 changed Zephyr thread state names and did not work with the Zephyr examples.
fix: Install RTOS Views 0.0.13 or later.

title: CMSIS Debugger: App does not resume from main() with Serial Monitor open (Nu-Link2 probe)
cause: The behaviour came from the Nu-Link2 debug probe firmware, not from the extension.
fix: Update the Nu-Link2 firmware to the latest release from Nuvoton.

message: Cannot call write after a stream was destroyed
title: CMSIS Debugger: Noisy "Selected thread is running" and "stream was destroyed" errors in Debug Console
cause: Views send requests while the target changes state (step/run, disconnect), and the adapter surfaced the resulting internal errors to the user.
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter to 2.6.0 or later. The related AC6 "not in symtab" warnings come from reading osRtxConfig.

title: RTX: osMutexRelease returns osErrorResource when called from another thread
cause: A mutex can only be released by its owner by definition.
fix: Use a semaphore initialised with one token when different threads acquire and release.

title: RTX: osMessageQueueNew fails with user control block that is larger than required
cause: RTX with safety features checks that cb_size equals the control block size exactly, contrary to CMSIS 5 text calling it a minimum.
fix: Pass exactly osRtxMessageQueueCbSize as cb_size.

title: RTX: No armasm port for CMSIS-RTX: GCC syntax .S files fail to assemble
cause: The GCC-syntax assembly files are also meant for Arm Compiler 6, but must be assembled by armclang, not armasm.
fix: Let the project build the .S files with armclang (set the assembler syntax with -masm=gnu if needed).

title: CMSIS Solution: Error for a non-existent pack version stays in PROBLEMS after correcting it
cause: The invalid version was still referenced in another file (for example the csolution.yml) when a valid one was added to the cproject.yml.
fix: Use Find in Files from the problem to remove the stale reference; the underlying fix is in devtools PR 2463 (nightly 2026-04-05).

title: CMSIS Solution: Changing a component's instance count makes it vanish after Save
cause: Editing instances changed the file references of the component and broke the view's mapping.
fix: Fixed in CMSIS Solution nightly of 2026-06-09 (reported on 1.67.2).

title: CMSIS Solution: Create Solution view shows no devices when Web Services is enabled
cause: The device search service returned an error because the number of devices (about 13,041) exceeded the search result window configured on the server (13,000). The server limit was raised to 15,000 afterwards; a client-side change was still pending.
fix: Server side already patched. If the list is still empty, disable Web Services, install the BSP and DFP packs for the board or device (copy the cpackget command from the board or device page on keil.arm.com and run it in a VS Code terminal) and pick the board from the installed packs.

title: CMSIS Solution: Switching to another solution keeps the previous target-set and shows a context error
cause: Backend bug that carried the active target-set selection from the previously opened solution.
fix: Use nightly toolbox/extension of 2026-06-12 or later.

title: CMSIS Solution: Deselecting the secure project removes Secure_CMSE_Lib.o; non-secure build fails
cause: The non-secure project uses $cmse-lib(CM33_s)$ from the secure build output; if that project is not part of the build the library does not exist, and the out folder is regenerated.
fix: Add a target-type (for example AVH-NS-only) whose set builds only the non-secure project and reference ../out/<secure>/<target>/$BuildType$/<lib>.o with for-context; build the full target first. Use load: none in the set to skip programming the secure part.

title: CMSIS Solution: Software Components stuck on 'Saving changes...' for layers outside solution folder
cause: The active solution tracker ignored changes in files outside the solution directory, so saving a clayer there never completed.
fix: Use CMSIS Solution nightly of 2026-07-03 or later.

title: CMSIS Solution: Debugger-only solution without projects shows 'Solution could not be loaded'
cause: A solution with no projects passed cbuild setup but the extension could not load it.
fix: Fixed in nightly of 2026-03-24; device and board information now show.

title: CMSIS Solution: CMSIS View does not refresh after changing target-type or target-set
cause: Missing update trigger for active target changes.
fix: Fixed in nightly from 2026-03-31; use Refresh (Reload Packs, Update RTE) as workaround on 1.66.0.

title: CMSIS Solution: CubeMX does not produce the cgen.yml after changing Project Manager settings
cause: cbridge cannot create the cgen.yml when no peripheral uses the HAL driver (for example all switched to LL). Same limitation as an open generator-bridge issue.
fix: Keep HAL selected for at least one peripheral so cbridge can write the cgen.yml, then generate again.

message: CMake Error: The source ".../AlgorithmTest.Debug+AppKit-E7-U55/CMakeLists.txt" does not match the source ".../DataTest.Debug+AppKit-E7-U55/CMakeLists.txt" used to generate cache.
title: CMSIS Solution: CMake source mismatch error after changing which projects are selected in a solution
cause: Adding or removing projects changes the list of contexts and hence the generated CMakeLists files at solution and context level, so the existing CMake cache of the earlier selection no longer matches.
fix: Rebuild (clean build) after changing the project selection. To switch between sets of projects without rebuilding, define a separate target-set for each set; each target-set uses its own tmp folder.

message: Command failed: 1
title: CMSIS Solution: CMake error 'Command failed: 1' for the database target after a successful build
cause: A user-set CMSIS_COMPILER_ROOT pointed to a toolbox etc folder that did not match the extension's CMSIS-Toolbox version, so the compile-database step failed.
fix: Unset CMSIS_COMPILER_ROOT or point it at the folder of the toolbox the extension uses.

message: csolution error: cproject not parsed, adding context failed
title: CMSIS Solution: Create Solution fails with 'cproject not parsed, adding context failed'
cause: Race: the solution was loaded before all project files were written to disk.
fix: Fix merged after 1.68.0; try Refresh (Reload Packs, Update RTE), which did not help for the reporter.

title: CMSIS-View: Downloaded eventlist for Linux is not executable
cause: The CI zip artifact step removed Unix permissions before the tar.gz was assembled.
fix: chmod +x eventlist; fixed in later releases by changing the packaging (PR 50).

title: cpackget: Stale pdsc files remain in .Web after a vendor withdraws packs from the index
cause: cpackget init only downloads the new index.pidx and does not clean .Web; removing pdsc files that are no longer listed is done by update-index -a.
fix: Run cpackget update-index -a; it prints a warning per pdsc no longer present in the index and deletes the file. Make sure copies of pdsc files keep file name and the name element consistent.

title: cpackget: Local pack clone with pdsc version 0.0.0 loses to installed pack releases
cause: A pack whose pdsc gets its release history generated in CI contains only a dummy release 0.0.0 in the working tree. Local repository entries are treated like installed packs, with precedence only for the same version, so any installed release with a higher version wins.
fix: Either add a release element to the local pdsc whose version equals or exceeds the newest installed release (and fix the history again before merging), or remove all installed versions of that pack from the pack cache so only the local repository entry remains. Projects with pack version constraints still select the constrained version.

title: csolution: Layer variable with relative path fails when the cproject is in a subdirectory
cause: A relative path assigned to a variable in the csolution.yml is evaluated relative to the cproject.yml that uses it, which sits in another directory.
fix: Workaround: prefix the variable in the layer node with the relative path to the solution folder, for example layer: ../$Board-Layer$. Access sequences were not yet accepted in layer: at the time of that report.

title: csolution: GCC link errors with generated linker script and startup file of old STM32F4xx_DFP
cause: The old STM32F4xx_DFP (2.17.1) startup file and generated GCC linker script do not match; ST families rely on STM32CubeMX for consistent startup and linker files.
fix: Use the latest STM32F4xx_DFP and set the project up with the CubeMX generator as the pack overview and the toolbox CubeMX documentation describe.

title: csolution: Schema check rejects define values with C integer suffixes U, UL, ULL
cause: The JSON schema pattern for define: values did not allow C-style suffixes on hex or decimal numbers.
fix: Schema extended; the allowed forms are now described in the define: section of the YML input format documentation. Update the toolbox if the schema check still rejects such a value.

title: csolution: Non-ASCII characters in user path become replacement characters in $G generator file
cause: Same encoding limitation as the non-ASCII project name problem: csolution does no UTF-8 conversion on Windows, so cbuild-gen.yml written under a profile path such as an accented user name contains the replacement character.
fix: Workaround: enable Windows Unicode UTF-8 worldwide language support, or work from a path with ASCII characters only.

title: csolution: CLANG fatal backend error on Cortex-M55 when the FPU is selected on its own
cause: With Compiler CLANG (LLVM Embedded Toolchain 22.1) and a Cortex-M55 device with FPU enabled, the option pair -mcpu=cortex-m55 -mfpu=fpv5-sp-d16 can trigger a fatal compiler backend error (a toolchain bug).
fix: Do not choose the FPU separately for Cortex-M55 with CLANG; if one must be given use -mfpu=fp-armv8-fullfp16-d16. The toolbox mitigation was validated in a nightly.

title: csolution: Component or variant names with parentheses etc. are rejected by the yml schema
cause: The component ID pattern in the csolution schemas was narrower than what the pack schema allows for Cclass, Cgroup, Csub and Cvariant (spaces, / ( ) . : + etc.).
fix: Pack and yml schemas were aligned in CMSIS-Toolbox 1.5.0; update the tools.

title: csolution: RTE/Device contains *.update@<version> files although no *.base@<version> exists
cause: An .update file is written whenever the pack's config file version differs from the one in the project or no base file is known; a base file can only be written when the original version is known. Mixed .base/.update output for one component was considered confusing.
fix: Behaviour changed in CMSIS-Toolbox 1.4.0: .base is created when a config file is first copied into the project RTE, and .update only if a .base exists.

title: csolution: misc options of a setup vanish from the cprj when several setups match one context
cause: When a context is matched by more than one setup, only the first matching setup is evaluated; its (possibly empty) misc block hides the misc options of later setups, and with the order swapped the defines of the other setups get lost.
fix: Keep one setup per context and put compiler-specific options into that setup, for example misc entries with a for-compiler: GCC key under the Debug and Release setups. Merging of additive options for several setups was added in CMSIS-Toolbox 2.0.0-dev2.

message: error csolution: generator 'STM32CubeMX' from component 'Keil::Device:STM32Cube Framework:STM32CubeMX@2.0.0': reading gpdsc failed
title: csolution: csolution 1.6 reports "reading gpdsc failed" for a hand-made gpdsc
cause: The placeholder gpdsc referenced conditions and generators without defining them; version 1.6.0 validates gpdsc files strictly.
fix: Make the gpdsc complete (define conditions and generators) or let the generator create it.

message: error csolution: one of the following devices must be specified:
title: csolution: found multiple mounted devices although device: is specified
cause: The board in the pack lists two mountedDevice entries with the same deviceIndex, which the specification does not allow, and csolution 2.5.0 did not cope with it even when device: named one of them.
fix: Fixed in a toolbox release after 2.5.0 so the specified device selects the mounted device. The pack should also use distinct deviceIndex values.

message: warning #500: pack 'ARM::CMSIS@6.0.0' is already defined in file <packs>/ARM/CMSIS/6.0.0/ARM.CMSIS.pdsc - duplicate is ignored
title: csolution: Warning #500 duplicate pack ignored when the pack vendor is written in a different case
cause: Pack names are matched case-insensitively on Windows, so pack: Arm::CMSIS finds the ARM::CMSIS folder while cbuild-pack.yml from an earlier run records the upper-case name, and the pack is seen twice.
fix: Write the vendor exactly as in the pack (ARM::CMSIS), including in cproject and clayer files, so projects stay portable to case-sensitive systems.

message: warning: Invalid state, unable to determine psp alias, assuming psp_s.
title: GDB: GDB warning "unable to determine psp alias, assuming psp_s" during Zephyr debug
cause: pyOCD Zephyr thread awareness does not model Secure and Non-secure state, so GDB cannot tell which PSP alias belongs to a paused thread.
fix: Ignore it: only the PSP/MSP alias register values of paused threads may be wrong. The unrelated "pc ... in read in CU" warning has the same harmless nature.

title: other: Debug of Alif DevKit-E8 with CMSIS-DAP fails
cause: The reset sequences in the Alif DFP 2.0.x were broken, and the device additionally had to be provisioned with the Alif security tools.
fix: Use Alif DFP 2.1.0 or later, a current CMSIS-Toolbox, and provision the device with the Alif SE tools when switching cores.

title: pyOCD: Live View / Memory Inspector values freeze while the CPU runs (Zephyr idle with WFI)
cause: pyOCD memory cache returns stale values when the target sits in sleep (WFI) in Zephyr idle; reads then do not reach the target. It shows with CMSIS-DAP and ULINKplus but not with J-Link.
fix: Disable the memory cache with -Ocache.enable_memory=false in the pyOCD arguments, or build Zephyr so that it skips WFI while debugging (CONFIG_ARM_ON_ENTER_CPU_IDLE_HOOK with a hook returning false).

title: pyOCD: pyocd gdb accepts only one client connection; dual-core semihosting output missing
cause: Without --persist pyOCD ends its GDB server after the first client disconnects, so a second attach fails. Semihosting for the second core only worked while both cores were attached, a known pyOCD limitation tracked separately.
fix: Add --persist when starting pyocd gdbserver, or use the generated CMSIS Run task which passes the required options. Attach both cores for semihosting output.

title: pyOCD: Device pack not found by 'pyocd pack --install' although it worked before
cause: The local pack index cache was stale or missing the entry.
fix: Run `pyocd pack -c` to clear the cache and `pyocd pack -u` to update the index, then install again.

title: pyOCD: pyocd reset with hardware reset does nothing on K64F
cause: The hardware reset path was broken for this target; software reset worked.
fix: Use 'pyocd reset -m sw' meanwhile; fixed in a later release.

title: pyOCD: reset_and_halt then resume logs 'cannot resume: target not halted'
cause: The message came from the automatic resume on disconnect, not from the resume call, so the script behaved correctly.
fix: Pass resume_on_disconnect=False; the message was reworded in change #1487.

title: pyOCD: pyOCD cannot step off a bkpt instruction compiled into the firmware
cause: A BKPT instruction in the code is not managed by pyOCD's breakpoint manager, so removing it does nothing, and resuming or stepping re-executes it forever. gdb cannot remove it either.
fix: Before resuming, check whether the instruction at PC is a bkpt and skip it: pc = target.read_core_register('pc'); if (target.read16(pc) & 0xff00) == 0xbe00: target.write_core_register('pc', pc + 2). In gdb use set $pc += 2. Native handling in pyOCD was planned.

title: pyOCD: S32K3xx hard-faults on gdb attach because the pack's RAMInitialize clears the vector table
cause: The Keil S32K3xx pack's RAMInitialize sequence, controlled by the debug variable DoRAMInitialize, clears RAM, and the reset sequence that should return the core to reset state does not run. A vector table moved to RAM is wiped and the core faults.
fix: Set the debug variable off: -Opack.debug_sequences.debugvars="DoRAMInitialize=0;". For attach after flashing, also use --connect under-reset and, as a pack patch, alias ResetCatchClear to ResetHardwareDeassert.

title: pyOCD: pyocd rtt cannot find the control block; using RTT with gdbserver needs monitor commands
cause: pyOCD's RTT control-block search only scans the first RAM region and a short range, so a block in a later RAM (for example 0x20002300 on LPC55S16, whose first RAM is code RAM) is not found. gdbserver has no preset, so RTT must be set up manually.
fix: Give pyocd rtt an explicit search address/size covering the RAM that holds _SEGGER_RTT. For gdbserver use: monitor rtt setup <address> <size> SEGGER RTT, monitor rtt start, monitor rtt server start <port> 0, monitor rtt channels, then connect with nc localhost <port>. Widening the default search range was planned.

title: pyOCD: i.MX RT1176 pack target: DebugPortStart not run and second core not created
cause: The RT1176 pack defines DebugPortStart per core, which the pack spec does not handle for multi-core debugging. In addition pyOCD wrongly applied its IMXRT family class to the pack target, and that class creates only the first core.
fix: Remove the family match for IMXRT pack targets in pyocd/target/family/__init__.py, or use a build containing the fix of PR 1594, which drops it. Then both cores are found. A branch honouring the pname of the debug sequences only runs DebugPortStart for the core named by the primary_core option. A user script is needed to release the second core.

title: pyOCD: STM32H753 firmware hard-faults after pyOCD flashing with the pack target
cause: The flash algorithm from the Keil STM32H7 pack can corrupt flash on these parts, so the programmed image is bad even though pyOCD reports success. A built-in target for the same die programs correctly.
fix: Use the built-in target stm32h743xx (or stm32h750xx) instead of the pack-provided H753 target, e.g. -t stm32h750xx. A pull request also corrected sector sizes and a wrong RDP security-lock detection on that built-in target.

title: pyOCD: cbuild-run load rejects IAR .out ELF files
cause: CMSIS-Toolbox names IAR output with the .out extension, which pyOCD's file programmer did not recognise as ELF.
fix: Fixed in a pyOCD commit that adds the extension; use a release containing it.

title: pyOCD: LPC802 flash write gives partly written words with old pyOCD
cause: With pyOCD 0.34.3 the LPC802 reset-and-halt behaved differently from later versions, and a single word written to flash came out with only some bits set until the write was repeated. A reporter reproduced it on 0.34.3 with both the Keil and NXP packs and found that 0.36.0 and later program the chip correctly, attributing it to the debug-sequence work in 0.35 and 0.36.
fix: Upgrade to pyOCD 0.36.0 or newer. If you must stay on 0.34.3, a user script with a will_reset/did_reset delegate that clears the reset vector catch and waits for the core to halt after reset worked around it. The original reporter had other chips fail on 0.36, so test your parts.

title: pyOCD: CMSIS-DAP v2 bulk: stray zero byte after transfers sized as multiple of endpoint size
cause: pyOCD's USB backend appends a dummy zero byte to bulk writes whose length is a multiple of wMaxPacketSize but shorter than the DAP packet size, to terminate the transfer. Probe firmware that treats every byte as data sees a bogus one-byte packet.
fix: The extra byte was introduced on purpose to end the USB transfer; a later change (#1882) altered it so it no longer shows up in the command stream. Update pyOCD or make probe firmware tolerate it.

title: pyOCD: RTT config node in pyocd.yaml opens no port with pyocd gdbserver
cause: The rtt: configuration node is only honoured by pyocd run, not by pyocd gdbserver, so no RTT server port is ever opened. Running RTT independently of a GDB client was also not supported by the remote probe server.
fix: With gdbserver, set RTT up through the GDB monitor commands after connecting: monitor rtt setup <control-block address> <search size> SEGGER RTT, then monitor rtt start, monitor rtt channels and monitor rtt server start <port> <channel>. Config-file support for gdbserver was announced for a later release.

title: pyOCD: pyocd hangs forever on first connect with hidapi backend on Windows
cause: The hidapi USB backend on Windows had no read timeout, so a read that never completes blocks the process and it cannot exit.
fix: Update to a pyOCD release that includes the fix for the hidapi read timeout (change #2011).

title: pyOCD: pip install pyocd fails in a virtualenv while building cmsis-pack-manager
cause: pip 20.0/20.0.1 broke the build of the cmsis-pack-manager source package inside virtual environments.
fix: Use pip 20.0.2 or newer (downgrading to pip below 20 also worked).

title: pyOCD: Flashing a .bin fails: pack has a flash algorithm but no flash memory element
cause: The device pack defines a flash algorithm for an address range but has no matching memory element for that flash, so pyocd finds no flash region.
fix: Add a memory element for the flash range to a local copy of the pack and pass it with --pack (or the pack session option). A pyocd change to derive a region from an algorithm without a memory was on the todo list.

title: pyOCD: pyocd list finds no CMSIS-DAP v1 probe because of the HID report descriptor
cause: pyOCD itself ignores the HID report descriptor, but on Windows and macOS the OS HID driver and the hidapi or pywinusb backends depend on it, as the kernel driver cannot be detached. A descriptor with unsuitable input and output items, or without a vendor usage on older Windows, makes the probe invisible. On Linux libusb is used directly and the descriptor does not matter.
fix: Use a vendor-defined usage page with a vendor usage, a 64-byte report size and both input and output reports declared (for example Input/Output with the Data, Variable, Absolute flags), and check the descriptor with the USB-IF HID descriptor tool.

title: pyOCD: Locking an nRF52 (enabling APPROTECT) with pyOCD
cause: Debug port protection on nRF52 is controlled by the APPROTECT field in the UICR flash region. The pyOCD security notes only describe unlocking.
fix: Create a 1 KiB file filled with 0xFF, set the byte at offset 0x208 to 0x00 (the PALL field of APPROTECT), and load it to the start of UICR with pyocd load -a 0x10001000 <file>.bin. After a reset the device should no longer be connectable (the tool then reports that no cores were found). The answer was derived from the datasheet and not tested on a full lock.

title: pyOCD: Adding an external RTOS or probe driver to pyOCD without editing its sources
cause: pyOCD loads its probe drivers and RTOS awareness modules as setuptools entry points, so out-of-tree packages can register themselves.
fix: Create a Python package that exports an entry point in the group pyocd.rtos or pyocd.probe. The entry point must reference a subclass of pyocd.core.plugin.Plugin whose load() returns the implementation (a ThreadProvider subclass for an RTOS). The built-in FreeRTOS plugin and the entry_points section of pyOCD's setup.cfg are the reference.

message: 'GenericRTTUpChannel' object has no attribute 'target'
title: pyOCD: RTT up channel bytes_available raises AttributeError on 'target'
cause: Typo in the RTT channel code: it used an attribute named target where the object stores it as _target.
fix: Fixed upstream; use a pyOCD release that includes the correction.

message: 0000542:CRITICAL:__main__:uncaught exception: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable
title: pyOCD: pyocd 0.29 crashes (NoneType) on probes without a USB serial string
cause: pyocd needs a serial number string from every probe to identify it. A CMSIS-DAP firmware that has no USB serial descriptor leaves it None. The earlier version seemed to work only because Windows had cached an old descriptor.
fix: Give the probe firmware a USB serial number string. A pyocd change that synthesises a stable ID from other USB data for such probes was in review at the time (CMSIS-DAP v1 via pyusb first).

message: 0000749:ERROR:__main__:uncaught exception: [Errno None] Other error
title: pyOCD: pyocd gdb as normal user fails on FreeBSD when detaching the kernel HID driver
cause: On open, the CMSIS-DAP USB backend tries to detach the kernel driver of the HID interface. An unprivileged user may not do that, and the resulting libusb error was not caught, so the session aborted. The detach is not needed for DAPLink to work.
fix: Run with a pyOCD that catches errors from the kernel-driver detach and carries on (fixed on master after 0.19.0). As a stop-gap, run as root or patch the detach call out.

message: 0001679:WARNING:rom_table:Invalid coresight component, cidr=0x0
title: pyOCD: STM32H750: invalid CoreSight component warnings, memory transfer fault, slow flashing
cause: On STM32H7 parts the trace clock is off after reset, so the CoreSight trace components cannot be read and are reported as invalid. A target made from a pack plus extra memory regions added in a user script can contain overlapping regions, which produces memory transfer faults (a single access crossing a region boundary). Flash speed is limited by the default 1 MHz SWD clock and the pre-programming flash read.
fix: In a did_reset() hook of the user script set bit 20 (TRACECLKEN, 0x00100000) in DBGMCU_CR at 0xE00E1004. Check the memory map with: pyocd cmd -c "show map" and remove overlapping regions; mark SDRAM with is_default=False and is_powered_on_boot=False. For speed use a higher SWD frequency (--frequency 10m) and, for development flows, -Osmart_flash=0.

message: 0005770 C flash init timed out [__main__]
title: pyOCD: pyocd load prints a TypeError in load-svd and "flash init timed out"
cause: The installed DFP version lacked the SVD file, so the SVD loader got None as path.
fix: Update the DFP to a version that ships the SVD; the cbuild-run file lists it under system-descriptions.

message: E Mass erase failed. [eraser]
title: pyOCD: i.MX RT mass erase prints 'Mass erase failed' although flash is erased
cause: The erase actually succeeded; the reported failure was a spurious message in 0.33.1 and the chosen reset type was not honoured by the target class.
fix: Verify by reading flash; the message is fixed in the next release.

message: ERROR: No matching distribution found for cmsis-pack-manager>=0.2.7 (from pyocd)
title: pyOCD: pip install pyocd 0.21.0 fails because cmsis-pack-manager has no build for the platform
cause: pyOCD 0.20 and later require cmsis-pack-manager, which contains compiled Rust code. On platforms without a prebuilt wheel (FreeBSD, some ARM hosts) pip could only see an old source version and the install failed.
fix: Install an older pyOCD such as `pip install pyocd==0.19.0`, or wait for or upgrade to cmsis-pack-manager 0.2.8 or newer, which builds with stable Rust.

message: Exception: b'\nrelative URL without a base'
title: pyOCD: pyocd pack update aborts with 'relative URL without a base'
cause: A pack vendor's index entry has a bad relative URL, and older cmsis-pack-manager versions abort the whole index update on one failing descriptor.
fix: Upgrade pyocd and cmsis-pack-manager (pyocd 0.34.3 with cmsis-pack-manager 0.5.2 skips failing descriptors and finishes the update).

message: FlashEraseFailure: erase_sector(0x400) error: 105
title: pyOCD: KV11Z flash erase_sector fails with error 105 on second programming
cause: Error 105 is the flash driver's command-failure status (erase verify failed), typically worn flash. Sector erase failed while chip erase worked on the same board.
fix: Add -O chip_erase=auto (or choose chip erase) so the whole chip is erased instead of sector by sector; also try another board to rule out worn flash.

message: FlashFailure: init error: 536870913
title: pyOCD: gdb 'load' after a chip erase fails on Kinetis with FlashFailure init error
cause: Initialising the flash algorithm in verify mode failed on K22F/K66F boards after the chip erase; both built-in and pack algorithms fail.
fix: Upgrade to a release after 0.26: pyOCD now retries the init in erase mode when verify init raises. Connecting under reset also improves stability.

message: Memory transfer fault (Error while running debug sequence 'ResetSystem' (core Cortex-M4): Memory transfer fault (SWD/JTAG communication failure (FAULT ACK)))
title: pyOCD: pack-based reset fails with FAULT ACK on ATSAM4L since pyOCD 0.44
cause: When a CMSIS-Pack defines no ResetSystem sequence, pyOCD 0.44 and later run a new built-in default reset sequence. On this Cortex-M4 part that default fails with a FAULT ACK, while the generic reset without the pack still works.
fix: Override the reset type so pyOCD uses its own SYSRESETREQ implementation instead of the default pack sequence: add -Oreset_type=sysresetreq to the reset, flash or load command. Confirmed to restore flashing.

message: No cores were discovered!
title: pyOCD: MIMXRT1050-EVK stops connecting after flashing: 'No cores were discovered'
cause: The application goes to deep sleep soon after reset (for example Mbed wait(0.2) with no other thread), and on this target the debugger cannot reconnect to a sleeping core; connect under reset did not help.
fix: Keep the target awake in debug builds: use wait_us() instead of wait(), or define the MBED_DEBUG macro to disable deep sleep. Recover a locked-out board with the DIP switch and erase.

message: OSError: cannot load library
title: pyOCD: PyInstaller build cannot load cmsis_pack_manager native library or plugins
cause: The frozen app lacks the native cmsis_pack_manager module and libusb library, so plugin loading fails and no probe is found.
fix: Add the libusb DLL and the cmsis_pack_manager native module as data/binaries in the PyInstaller spec (see the pyOCD discussion on binary builds).

message: SyntaxError: invalid syntax
title: pyOCD: pyocd-gdbserver appears to hang or fails with SyntaxError on Windows
cause: Old pyOCD only runs on Python 2; under Python 3 the entry point raises SyntaxError. Without a recognised board the server simply waits for one, and K64F firmware older than 0242 needs the Windows serial driver to be visible.
fix: Use Python 2.7 with that pyOCD version, update the interface firmware (0242 or newer) or install the mbed serial driver, and confirm the board is listed with `-l`.

message: Target type mimxrt1171dvmab not recognized. Use 'pyocd list --targets' to see currently available target types.
title: pyOCD: pyocd pack install silently installs nothing when index and pdsc versions differ
cause: The pack index lists one version of the pack, but the vendor's pdsc file lists a newer release first. pyOCD builds its index from the newest release, then looks for a cached pdsc under that version name, which does not exist, so the pack download never starts and no error is shown. Several NXP packs were non-compliant with the pack schema.
fix: Download the pack file yourself in the version the index really offers and pass it directly, for example: pyocd flash --target MIMXRT1171DVMAB --pack=NXP.MIMXRT1171_DFP.25.12.00.pack <image>. The vendor was fixing the metadata for its next pack release.

message: Target type stm32f407vgtx not recognized. Use 'pyocd list --targets' to see currently available target types.
title: pyOCD: 'Target type ... not recognized' for an STM32 board; pack not installed
cause: The target comes from a CMSIS-Pack that was not installed. Errors from 'pyocd pack update' about vendor servers are expected, and large packs download slowly without progress.
fix: Run 'pyocd pack update' then 'pyocd pack install <part>' and wait for the download to finish.

message: WARN Unknown file catogory preIncludeLocal, Group: Unity, Class: Tes
title: pyOCD: Wall of warnings on 'pyocd pack -u' and a missing STM32G0 pack
cause: Many vendor packs contain malformed PDSC data and the underlying cmsis-pack-manager prints a warning for each; it also did not know the preIncludeLocal file category. With 0.30.3 the STM32G071 device was additionally not found through the index.
fix: The warnings are harmless. If the device is not found, download the DFP .pack file manually and pass it with `--pack <file.pack>`; later pyOCD/pack-manager releases find Keil.STM32G0xx_DFP normally.

message: error trying to connect: invalid certificate: UnknownIssuer
title: pyOCD: pyocd pack update reports certificate errors and 404s for some vendors
cause: Some vendor servers have expired TLS certificates or incomplete chains that browsers tolerate but cmsis-pack-manager does not; 404s were a known cmsis-pack-manager defect.
fix: Only vendors' own sites must fix this. Download the packs manually from the Keil pack list and use pyocd --pack <file>.

message: no memory region defined for address 0x1ffff800
title: pyOCD: Cannot write STM32F1 option bytes: no memory region defined at 0x1ffff800
cause: The pack lists the option-byte flash algorithm as non-default, so pyOCD does not create a flash region for it.
fix: Add the region yourself in a pyocd_user.py script: load the unprocessed pack algorithms and add a FlashRegion for the option-byte algorithm to the memory map.

message: pyocd.core.exceptions.TargetSupportError: Target type mimxrt1160_cm7 not recognized.
title: pyOCD: Target type mimxrt1160_cm7 not recognized when flashing with west -r pyocd
cause: The board ID table maps the RT1160 EVK to a target type that does not exist as a built-in target; it was a mistake in the table.
fix: Install the device through its CMSIS-Pack as described in the target support documentation and select that target, or try the built-in mimxrt1170_cm7 target.

message: pyocd.probe.pydapaccess.dap_access_api.DAPAccessIntf.TransferError: No ACK received
title: pyOCD: ATSAMD21G18A connect fails with No ACK; deprecated Keil pack shadows Microchip pack
cause: Two packs describe the same part and the pack cache is keyed by part number, so the deprecated Keil pack for ATSAMD21G18A wins and cannot connect to this chip.
fix: Install the Microchip pack by naming a part only in that pack, for example pyocd pack install ATSAMD21J17D. Alternatively delete the Keil pdsc entry from the local pack cache.

message: usb.core.USBTimeoutError: [Errno 110] Operation timed out
title: pyOCD: XDS110-based LaunchPad: USB read timeout during flash
cause: The probe firmware does not cope with several outstanding CMSIS-DAP requests; reads time out.
fix: Add -Ocmsis_dap.limit_packets to prevent multiple outstanding commands. Note: reflashing an identical image is skipped by smart flash; use -Osmart_flash=0 to force programming.

title: svdconv: svdconv: DerivedFrom not found when enumeratedValues has the same name as its field
cause: svdconv's derive lookup first checks whether the referenced name equals the current item (a shortcut for named and unnamed containers), and when the types differ (field vs enumeratedValues) it reports derivedFrom as not found.
fix: Give the enumeratedValues container a name different from its field name and refer to it by full path from the peripheral level if needed. A real fix of the derive mechanism was postponed.

message:
*** WARNING M382: RESET_MASK.svd (Line 51)
  Register 'ABS': Reset Mask '0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF' does not fit into Register width: 64 Bit.
title: svdconv: SVDConv M382 reset mask does not fit for a 64-bit register
cause: The check of the reset mask against the register width was calculated wrongly for 64-bit registers.
fix: Fixed in a later SVDConv release (64-bit mask calculation corrected). Note that 64-bit registers are not officially supported by svdconv.

title: cbuild: CLANG 19 fails to compile for Armv8.1-M with --target=armv8.1m.main-none-unknown-eabihf
cause: LLVM Embedded Toolchain 19.1.1 expects target triples starting with thumbv7m, thumbv8m, thumbv8.1m instead of armv7m, armv8m, armv8.1m, which the CLANG toolchain file of the toolbox used.
fix: Fixed in the CLANG cmake file of CMSIS-Toolbox 2.7.0; update the toolbox. Before that the file CLANG.17.0.1.cmake in the toolbox etc folder could be replaced by the one from devtools main.

title: cbuild: cbuild setup fails because image files in a target-set are not built yet
cause: Images listed under target-set images: (for example post-build signed .bin files) were checked as dependencies during setup, and evaluating the $OutDir()$ access sequences created cyclic dependencies, so setup failed before anything could be built.
fix: Fixed in toolbox nightly 2.12.0-41 and later; update. Output directories via $OutDir()$ work afterwards.

title: cbuild: Breakpoints cannot be set when debugging a cbuild-built .axf in uVision
cause: Debug information in the image contains the source paths of the build machine (for example a Linux or WSL path), which uVision cannot find on the debug host, so no line information is usable.
fix: In uVision enter the SET SRC=<path to the sources> debug command (UNC paths work) so it can locate the sources; also use -gdwarf-4 for assembler files if needed.

title: cbuild: GCC link fails with undefined references between static libraries because of link order
cause: GNU ld scans an archive only once in command-line order, so libraries that reference each other circularly (many small component libraries) fail to link. cbuild passed the libraries without a rescan group.
fix: The GCC toolchain cmake file was changed to wrap the library list in -Wl,--start-group ... -Wl,--end-group (set(LIB_FILES -Wl,--start-group ${LIB_FILES} -Wl,--end-group)). The CMake LINK_GROUP genex is not usable because it needs CMake 3.24. Fixed in a CMSIS-Toolbox release after 1.7; as a local patch edit GCC.<version>.cmake.

title: cbuild: misc options on a single file are missing in compile_commands.json
cause: The cbuildgen backend did not honor file-level misc: options in the compile command.
fix: Use the cbuild2cmake backend (--cbuild2cmake) or upgrade to toolbox 2.4.0 where it is fixed.

title: cbuild: Whole AC6 map file is printed in the build terminal with CMake 4
cause: A bare --map linker option in cdefault.yml makes armlink print the map to stdout. CMake 3 silently added a --list file option, CMake 4 does not.
fix: Remove --map from misc and request the map through output: type: [map] in the *.cproject.yml. The output node is not allowed in *.csolution.yml.

title: cbuild: Adding a symdefs/ROM symbol file to an AC6 project gives a format error
cause: Files are classified by extension. A symbol file with .icf is taken as an IAR linker script, and one without a known extension is not passed to armlink as an object.
fix: Declare the file with category: object in the group (file: <name>, category: object) or give it the .o extension so it appears on the armlink command line.

message:
*** ERROR M204:
  Path not found: '...<projectdir>/RTE/_Target_1'!
title: cbuild: ERROR M204 path not found: RTE/_Target_1 when the solution has no build-type
cause: With a target-type but no build-type, csolution names the file <project>+<target-type>.cprj and the context RTE folder RTE/_<target-type>, but cbuildgen did not treat '+' as separator and looked for the placeholder folder _Target_1, which cbuild does not create by default.
fix: Add a build-type to the csolution.yml, or run cbuild once with --update-rte so the folder is created. Fixed in CMSIS-Toolbox 1.7.0.

message:
*** ERROR M800:
  RTE Model reports: Error R817: Toolchain not supported by project: GCC: gpio-toggle+STM32U585I-IOT02A.cprj
title: cbuild: ERROR M800 / R817 Toolchain not supported by project when using --toolchain on a cprj
cause: A cprj describes one compiler; two compiler: keys in a cproject do not produce a multi-compiler project.
fix: Declare one build-type per compiler (compiler: AC6, compiler: GCC) in csolution.yml so csolution generates one cprj per compiler.

message: ARMCM0.GCC/math_helper.c:103: undefined reference to `log10'
title: cbuild: GCC link error undefined reference to log10 because -lm is placed before the objects
cause: Everything under misc: Link: is put in front of the object files in the linker command line, so -lm and similar libraries are not resolved.
fix: Use the new misc: Library: node (for example - -lm - -lc - -lgcc - -lnosys), which is placed after the objects. Available since CMSIS-Toolbox 1.7.0.

message: The target name "Hello.Debug+AVH Test" is reserved or not valid for certain CMake features, such as generator expressions, and may result in undefined behavior.
title: cbuild: CMake error about invalid target name when a context name contains a blank
cause: Project, build-type and target-type names form the context name, which becomes a CMake target name; blanks and other characters CMake restricts are not allowed.
fix: Use names without blanks (underscore or dash instead). The restriction was added to the toolbox documentation.

message: error: unexpected token at start of statement
title: cbuild: AC6 assembler error: unexpected token at start of statement for an ST startup .s file
cause: The startup file is written in armasm syntax (; comments) but armclang assembles it as GNU assembler by default.
fix: Add misc: - ASM: - -masm=auto to the build type (written as a single option with = and no spaces).

message: exit.c:(.text.exit+0x16): undefined reference to `_exit'
title: cbuild: for-type with a comma list on one line is not a YAML list; file silently not compiled
cause: for-type: .GCC, .GCC_STATUS written on one line is a single YAML string, not a list, so the filter matched neither type and the source file was left out.
fix: Write the type list as a YAML sequence: for-type: [.GCC, .GCC_STATUS] or one entry per line. The documentation example was corrected.

message: fatal error: 'c_specific_header.h' file not found
title: cbuild: Files declared as headerC/includeC in a pack are missing from the include search path
cause: The tools only implemented the pack specification up to 1.7.7, so the language-specific file categories headerC and includeC were ignored; only header/include added -I paths.
fix: Use the plain header/include categories, or move to CMSIS-Toolbox 2.5.0 or later where cbuild2cmake supports the language and scope attributes.

message: ld.lld: error: duplicate symbol: _start
title: cbuild: LLVM embedded 20.1.0 link fails with duplicate symbol _start
cause: The Clang 20 runtime already links crt0 itself, so the extra -lcrt0 in the default linker options defined the start symbols twice.
fix: Remove -lcrt0 from the Clang linker options in cdefault.yml, or use a toolbox nightly after 6 May 2025 (devtools PR 2066).

title: CMSIS-Core: tiarmclang build fails: __PROGRAM_START resolves to _start instead of _c_int00
cause: CMSIS 6 uses the generic clang header, where the program start symbol is _start, while the TI compiler runtime uses _c_int00.
fix: Define __PROGRAM_START as _c_int00 (and __INITIAL_SP as __stack) before including the device header for TI clang, or use the CMSIS_6 version containing the TI specifics in the clang header (PR 315).

message: warning: "__ARM_FP" is not defined, evaluates to 0 [-Wundef]
title: CMSIS-Core: Warning "__ARM_FP is not defined" with soft float
cause: The headers used __ARM_FP without defined() checks.
fix: Fixed by guarding with defined(__ARM_FP) in all profiles (PR 124).

title: CMSIS Debugger: Live Watch, Component Viewer, Core Peripherals stale after variable or memory write
cause: The views did not react to the DAP events (invalidated, memory) that the adapter sends when memory changes through variable edits or GDB set commands, so only the built-in Watch refreshed.
fix: Use CDT GDB Adapter 2.9.0 together with CMSIS Debugger 1.7.1 or later.

title: CMSIS Debugger: Mark Active Source Lines switches itself off after every debug session
cause: The CDT GDB Adapter extension wrote cdt.debug.sourceHighlighting=false to the persisted settings when a GDB session ended.
fix: Update the CDT GDB Adapter extension (eclipse-cdt.cdt-gdb-vscode) to 2.9.1 or later. As a stopgap, re-enable the highlighting through the editor context menu, which sets the setting again.

title: CMSIS Debugger: Typing GDB commands in the Debug Console gives var-create errors
cause: The Debug Console treats input as expressions; the CDT GDB Adapter takes GDB CLI commands only with a ">" prefix.
fix: Start the command with ">" for example "> help".

title: CMSIS Debugger: Leftover pyOCD process blocks later sessions with "Access denied"
cause: After a failed launch (for example missing GDB) the adapter left the pyOCD server running.
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter to 2.1.0 or later; as a workaround end the pyocd process.

title: CMSIS Debugger: Target reset button disappears when a second core is attached
cause: The launch configuration of the second core had no customResetCommands.
fix: Use a CMSIS Solution release with the updated debug adapter templates, or add customResetCommands to the attach configuration.

title: CMSIS Debugger: Peripheral view does not update during single stepping
cause: The debug-tracker-vscode extension (dependency of RTOS Views) clashed with the Peripheral Inspector, which could not tell session IDs apart.
fix: Update Peripheral Inspector to 1.8.1 or later; disabling mcu-debug.debug-tracker-vscode also helps.

title: CMSIS Debugger: PERIPHERALS view missing when attaching to a GDB server started by Load & Run
cause: The attach launch configuration did not pass the cbuild-run file, so the SVD path was not found.
fix: Use CMSIS Debugger 1.0.0 or later with CMSIS Solution templates that add cmsis/cbuildRunFile to attach configurations; or add that setting manually.

title: CMSIS Debugger: XRTOS view shows "No RTOS detected" or no threads for RTX5 while the application runs
cause: The RTOS view reads RTOS data only while the target is halted and after osKernelStart.
fix: Pause the target after the kernel started; the threads then show.

message: -var-create: unable to create variable object
title: CMSIS Debugger: Hover shows "-var-create: unable to create variable object" for non-variables
cause: Hovering text that is no variable made the adapter report the GDB error.
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter to 2.0.4 or later.

message: No view is registered with id: cmsis-debugger.componentViewer
title: CMSIS Debugger: "No view is registered with id: cmsis-debugger.componentViewer" after extension update
cause: After updating from a release without Component Viewer to one with it, and only restarting extensions, VS Code has not registered the new view container.
fix: Reload or restart the VS Code window after the update. Newer versions show a warning with a Reload Window button when they detect this state.

message: Undefined command: "".  Try "help".
title: CMSIS Debugger: GDB Python pretty printers fail: bundled arm-none-eabi-gdb has no Python support
cause: The GDB used by the extension is the non-Python build of the Arm GNU Toolchain GDB. Sourcing a .py file therefore fails. The Python-enabled sibling arm-none-eabi-gdb-py needs a separately installed Python 3.8; without it the executable silently exits (a missing python38.dll on Windows) and the gdbserver is killed.
fix: Install Python 3.8 and set "gdb": "arm-none-eabi-gdb-py" in the launch configuration. Copying a Python 3.8 embeddable package next to the GDB executable also worked for one user. The maintainers only test the non-Python build and planned a troubleshooting note.

message: gdbserver has exited with code 1
title: CMSIS Debugger: GDB server fails to start but the adapter keeps waiting for a timeout
cause: The adapter did not notice early exit of the GDB server.
fix: Update CDT GDB Adapter to 2.1.0 or later; check the server error in the console.

message: Error: L6218E: Undefined symbol osRtxThreadStackCheck (referred from irq_armv7m.o).
title: RTX: L6218E undefined osRtxThreadStackCheck after disabling stack overrun checking in uVision
cause: The source is correct (guarded by RTX_STACK_CHECK); the IDE did not rebuild the assembler module after RTX_Config.h changed.
fix: Do a full Rebuild.

message: Error: selected processor does not support requested special purpose register -- `mrseq r0,msp'
title: RTX: Compiling RTX for Cortex-A7 gives special purpose register errors
cause: The M-profile file irq_armv7m.S was compiled for an A-profile target, and irq_armv7a.S was built with -mthumb and without FPU flags.
fix: Use irq_armv7a.S for Cortex-A, compile it in ARM mode without -mthumb and with proper FPU flags; or use the RTX_Library csolution.

title: CMSIS Solution: clangd reports a header of a newly added component as not found until Rebuild all
cause: compile_commands.json for clangd was not refreshed after components were added.
fix: Fixed with CMSIS-Toolbox nightly 2026-05-07 (cbuild2cmake) and the matching extension; run Rebuild all on older versions.

title: CMSIS Solution: uVision opens only the secure project for TrustZone solutions
cause: uVision still relies on the context-set while CMSIS Solution uses target-set.
fix: Generate a cbuild-set containing both contexts: cbuild setup <solution>.csolution.yml -S -c *.Debug.

title: CMSIS Solution: Stuck on 'Loading Solution...' with empty key in environmentVariables setting
cause: A setting with an empty name caused an unhandled error that blocked solution loading.
fix: Remove the empty "": "" entry from settings.json; fixed in nightly of 2026-06-25 where settings are validated.

title: CMSIS Solution: tasks.json keeps old image or target arguments after a target change and Build
cause: Debug tasks and launch configuration were not updated when csolution convert regenerated cbuild-run.yml during build.
fix: Use CMSIS Solution nightly of 2026-07-14 or later; it saves pending changes per task.saveBeforeRun and refreshes tasks.json. Workaround: press Save in Manage Solution.

title: CMSIS Solution: CMSIS View and PROBLEMS do not update after a generator creates the cgen.yml file
cause: Regression: file watches are derived from cbuild-idx.yml, which did not list the not-yet-existing cgen.yml.
fix: Fixed with csolution listing the cgen file in cbuild-idx.yml and CMSIS Solution nightly of 2026-07-24; refresh manually on older versions.

title: CMSIS Solution: Create Solution from a reference app with several csolution files edits the wrong solution
cause: The reference application contains three *.csolution.yml files in one folder; the create flow copies the app and takes 'the' solution file, which was not the selected one.
fix: Fixed in the CMSIS Solution nightly of 2026-09-18 by using the load value of the pack description. Note the new target must be selected in Manage Solution before compiler and layer selection starts.

title: CMSIS Solution: ${env:AVH_FVP_PLUGINS} empty in tasks and launch.json until window reload
cause: The Arm Tools Environment Manager activates the variable after VS Code has built the environment used by its ${env:...} resolver, and the resolver is not refreshed afterwards. process.env in the extension host already has the value.
fix: Run Developer: Reload Window after the environment was activated; this makes ${env:AVH_FVP_PLUGINS} available for Load & Debug. It is documented in the CMSIS Solution tips and tricks.

title: CMSIS Solution: Opening the CubeMX generator does nothing with CMSIS Solution 1.72 on macOS and Linux
cause: A regression in version 1.72: the generator is started in a pseudo terminal, and on Linux and macOS that terminal ends when cbridge detaches, before the generator has loaded.
fix: Copy the launch command from the CMSIS Solution output channel (csolution run <solution>.csolution.yml -g CubeMX -a <target>) and run it in a normal VS Code terminal; or go back to version 1.70. The fix was included in the nightly build of 2 October 2026.

title: CMSIS Solution: cbridge writes wrong relative paths for middleware files in cgen.yml (e.g. FreeRTOS)
cause: For middleware selected in the CubeMX .ioc the relative path of the files was computed without the STM32CubeMX folder prefix, so the build did not find the sources.
fix: Use cbridge 0.9.19-23 or later (toolbox 2.13.0 and CMSIS Solution 1.64.2) and let CubeMX regenerate to rewrite the cgen.yml.

message: '..' is not recognized as an internal or external command,
title: CMSIS Solution: Browse for UV4.exe in Manage Solution inserts a relative path and launching uVision fails
cause: The relative path was passed unresolved to the shell task.
fix: Fixed in nightly 1.66.1-32; enter an absolute path on older versions.

message: error csolution: undefined variables in Demo.csolution.yml:
title: CMSIS Solution: Layer selection omits the empty variable (Shield-Layer: ) for unused layers
cause: Layer variables of the cproject must be set, with an empty string when a layer is unused; the extension stopped writing the empty value, so the build failed and the dialog reopened.
fix: Use CMSIS Solution nightly of 2026-07-13 or later; as a workaround add the variable with an empty string value to the csolution.yml.

message: warning #500: pack 'ARM::CMSIS-NN@4.1.0' is duplicated:
title: CMSIS Solution: Switching solutions reports 'pack ... is duplicated' for solution-local packs
cause: Local packs of the previously loaded solution stayed in the pack cache when another solution was loaded.
fix: Fixed in CMSIS Solution nightly of 2026-06-29; solution-local packs are removed on reload.

title: cpackget: cpackget add -f packs.txt downloads required packs that are already installed
cause: The check for already satisfied requirement packs did not handle the internal unbounded upper version marker, so installed dependencies were not recognised.
fix: Use cpackget 0.9.4 or later.

title: cpackget: cpackget add ARM::CMSIS@>=6.0.0 exits with code 255 and prints nothing
cause: The unquoted > is interpreted by the shell as redirection, so the real error (bad pack name) is written to a file named after the version.
fix: Quote the argument (cpackget add "ARM::CMSIS@>=6.0.0") or check for a stray file named 6.0.0 in the working directory.

title: cpackget: cpackget add Vendor::Pack@>=3.0.0 silently does nothing on the Windows command line
cause: The shell treats > as output redirection before cpackget starts, so the version text becomes a file name and the message goes into that file. The same applies to ^ in cmd.
fix: Quote the pack specification: cpackget add "Keil::STM32U5xx_DFP@>=3.0.0" or "Vendor::Pack@^3.0.0".

message: E: Get "https://keil.com/pack/ARM.CMSIS.5.9.0.pack": tls: failed to verify certificate: x509: certificate has expired or is not yet valid
title: cpackget: cpackget add of a keil.com URL fails with an expired certificate error
cause: The URL without www points to a host with an expired certificate; the official pack host is www.keil.com. Typing URLs by hand also bypasses the index lookup.
fix: Use cpackget add ARM::CMSIS@5.9.0 so cpackget resolves the URL from the index, or use https://www.keil.com/pack/... in the URL.

message: E: The latest release (1.15.0) in pack's pdsc (ARM.CMSIS-DSP.pdsc) does not match pack version ""
title: cpackget: Installing a local pack fails while resolving its dependencies
cause: Regression in the cpackget version of toolbox 2.3.0: the version of a dependency given with a modifier was lost, so an empty version was requested.
fix: Use toolbox 2.2.1 until upgrading, or 2.4.0 and later where it is fixed; installing the dependency by hand with cpackget add <pack>@<version> also works.

message: E: bad pack name: it must be either a PackID:  packVendor::Pack[@version|@~version|@^version|@>=version] or a local Pack file: <path>/Vendor.Pack.version.pack or a local Pack Description file: <path>/
title: cpackget: cpackget rejects pack files whose version is not semantic (e.g. NAMEv0.051)
cause: cpackget validates pack names and requires numeric major.minor.patch versions in file name and pdsc release tag. Legacy packs with other version strings fail.
fix: Install such packs with the Keil_v5/UV4/packunzip tool instead.

message: E: bad pack name: it should be one of the following formats: Vendor.Pack, Vendor.Pack.x.y.z, Vendor.Pack.x.y.z.pack, or Vendor.Pack.pdsc
title: cpackget: cpackget rejects pack versions with leading zeros such as 1.22.02
cause: The strict semantic-versioning regular expression disallowed leading zeros in numeric fields, but the pack schema permits them.
fix: Use a cpackget after 0.5.0 where the expression was relaxed (install folders keep the leading zeros).

message: E: expected element type <index> but have <html>
title: cpackget: cpackget init fails with 'expected element type <index> but have <html>'
cause: The index URL was given without www; keil.com redirects to a web page, so an HTML document was downloaded instead of index.pidx.
fix: Use the exact URL https://www.keil.com/pack/index.pidx.

message: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
title: cpackget: cpackget add crashes (nil pointer) with a locally generated index.pidx
cause: vidx2pidx wrote the index file name into the url element (file:///.../index.pidx), so cpackget built a doubled path index.pidx/index.pidx and then dereferenced a missing file info instead of reporting an error.
fix: Use a CMSIS-Toolbox nightly from 2026-09-16 or later, where both vidx2pidx and cpackget are fixed; the url element of a local index must name only the folder (file:///C:/packs/Vendor/). As a workaround place an update.cfg in .Web with a future Date and Auto=false to suppress the implicit update-index.

title: csolution: Context set with several -c values or a comma list behaves unexpectedly
cause: Several contexts can be given as repeated -c options or as one comma-separated list, but there must be no space after a comma, otherwise the second name is not read as part of the option.
fix: Use csolution convert <solution> -c cm33_s.Debug+AVH -c cm33_ns.Release+AVH, or -c a,b without spaces.

title: csolution: Duplicate entry error in cbuild.yml when a define repeats one set by the device
cause: The solution defined CPU_K32L3A60VPJ1A_cm4 itself although the pack's device description already adds that define, so the generated cbuild.yml listed it twice and the schema reported a duplicate.
fix: Remove the redundant define from the csolution. The duplicate tolerance was addressed in CMSIS-Toolbox 2.3.0.

title: csolution: Generated regions header ignores memory defined in the board of a BSP
cause: With automatic linker script generation (linker: - auto:) only memory from the device was written to regions_<board>.h; memory elements of the board (for example external RAM and flash from the BSP) were missing.
fix: Fixed in CMSIS-Toolbox 2.4.0; update.

title: csolution: pyOCD launch error because cbuild-run.yml has a dbgconf node the device does not define
cause: csolution wrote dbgconf: into cbuild-run.yml even when the pack's debugvars element has no configfile attribute, so the debugger tried to use a file that does not exist.
fix: Fixed in toolbox builds after 2.9.0; the dbgconf node is only written when the pack specifies a configfile.

title: csolution: list dependencies suggests components from other bundles of the same Cclass
cause: When a bundled component needed another component of the same Cclass, csolution offered candidates from all bundles although components of different bundles of one class cannot be selected together.
fix: Fixed in toolbox builds after 2.10.0; only components from the same bundle are proposed now.

title: csolution: Schema check rejects pname: under memory: in a target-type
cause: The documented memory: child node pname: was missing from the JSON schema, so the schema check failed although the documentation lists it.
fix: Fixed in a toolbox build after 2.14.1; update. Reporter confirmed with a nightly.

title: csolution: csolution convert uses lots of memory when the solution lists no packs
cause: Without a packs section csolution loaded every installed pack, which can exhaust memory in CI or cloud environments.
fix: Since csolution 1.2.0 only the latest pack versions are loaded by default; use --load required to load only the packs named in csolution.yml (fails if none are listed), or --load all for the old behaviour.

title: csolution: Old yml projects fail the schema check: optimize and warnings values changed in 1.2
cause: Schema 1.2 replaced the optimize values (max, size, speed, debug) by size, speed, balanced, none and the warnings values (no, all, Misra, AC5-like) by on and off; the old values had never been processed by the tools.
fix: Edit the yml files to the new values. It is a deliberate compatibility break of the schema.

title: csolution: Generated code ends up in ./generated instead of RTE/Device/<device> for CubeMX generator
cause: csolution used its own generator directory even when the pack's <generator> element prescribes workingDir and gpdsc location (for example $PRTE/Device), so MDK/Eclipse and csolution disagreed.
fix: Fixed in CMSIS-Toolbox 1.5.0: when the pack's generator element sets workingDir or gpdsc with a fixed location, the user cannot override the directory in csolution.yml.

title: csolution: Clang build lacks -mfpu, causing wrong FPU instructions and hard faults
cause: -mfpu had been removed from the Clang toolchain description because older Clang versions crashed with it. Without it a single-precision FPU target such as Cortex-M7 FPv5-SP may get double-precision instructions.
fix: Use a CMSIS-Toolbox that re-added -mfpu (merged after 2.13.0, in nightlies). Check compile_commands.json for -mfpu=fpv5-sp-d16. If the VS Code extension still shows the old behaviour, point CMSIS_SOLUTION_TOOLBOX to the newer toolbox.

message:
*** ERROR M204:
  Path not found: 'C:/xxx/non_secure/$cmse-lib(secure)!
title: csolution: cmse-lib access sequence error for the non-secure project since 2.5.0
cause: From 2.5.0 the CMake backend resolves $cmse-lib(project)$ to the selected build of the secure project, so that project must be part of the same context set. Building the non-secure context alone cannot resolve it (2.4.0 mapped it to the same build and target type by convention).
fix: Select both projects, for example cbuild <solution> --context CM33s.Release+CS300 --context CM33ns.Debug+CS300, or use a context-set for the whole target type.

message: /.cbuild-pack.yml - error csolution: file cannot be written
title: csolution: unexpected instance type for empty variables: node, then cbuild-pack.yml not written
cause: A variables: node in a target-type had no valid - variable: entries (all items were commented out), so the YAML is invalid; the second error line was only a follow-up with an empty path.
fix: Remove the empty variables: node or give it at least one list entry. Later toolbox builds no longer print the misleading second error.

message: /Simple+MCXN947VDF.cbuild-run.yml:193:11 - error csolution: unexpected instance type
title: csolution: cbuild-run.yml invalid: empty debug sequence block gives unexpected instance type
cause: An empty <block/> in a pack's debug sequence (or one containing only comments) was written as an empty map into cbuild-run.yml, which then failed its own schema check.
fix: Fixed in toolbox nightly 435 and later: empty blocks are no longer emitted. Workaround before: remove the empty <block/> from the pdsc.

message: Path not found: /trustzone_examples/hello_world/cm33_core0/hello_world_ns/..\hello_world_s\$Project$\$Compiler$\$BuildType$hello_world_s.debug+Board_CMSE_Lib.o
title: csolution: $Output(...)$ access sequences stay unresolved in output-dirs for inter-project references
cause: Access sequences inside output-dirs were not evaluated when another project referenced the output of a sibling project; also output-dirs is only accepted in csolution.yml, a key in cproject.yml triggers a warning that it was not recognized.
fix: Fixed in CMSIS-Toolbox 1.1.0. Put output-dirs into csolution.yml, not into cproject.yml.

message: RTE/Device/MCXN947VDF_cm33_core0/regions_NXP::FRDM-MCXN947.h - warning csolution: specified regions header was not found
title: csolution: Regions header not found when board: includes the vendor and $Bname$ is used
cause: $Bname$ expanded to the whole board string including vendor::, so the file name looked up differs from the generated regions_<board>.h.
fix: Workaround: write board: without the vendor:: prefix. Fixed in toolbox nightlies after 2.6.1.

message: Segmentation fault (core dumped)
title: csolution: Segmentation fault in csolution convert when a pack file name ends with a folder path
cause: A pack <file> element whose name attribute is a directory (path/) instead of path/name.ext crashed the parser, and packchk did not flag it.
fix: Use proper file names in the pdsc. Fixed in packchk 1.3.98, shipped with CMSIS-Toolbox 1.5.0.

message: armclang: error: no such file or directory: '@<absolute_path>/../../../Core/compiler_args.txt'
title: csolution: Paths of a CubeMX component duplicated and wrong when a setups: node is present
cause: With a Device:CubeMX component plus a setups: node in the cproject.yml, csolution emitted every path twice, the second copy resolved against the wrong base directory so it escaped the project.
fix: Fixed in a CMSIS-Toolbox nightly after 2.14.1 (build 2.14.1-68 confirmed); update the toolbox. Putting the options in a plain misc: node instead of setups: avoided the problem before.

message:
csolution error: Blank_solution+PIC32CZ8110CA90208.cbuild-run.yml:702:7
  - items have to be unique for this array
title: csolution: cbuild-run.yml rejected: flash blocks must be unique, but pdsc repeats blocks
cause: A flashinfo section with several identical block elements separated by gaps is valid per the PDSC specification, but the cbuild-run schema demanded unique array items.
