fix: Schema relaxed (uniqueItems false for the blocks array); fixed in toolbox builds from late April 2026 onward.

message: error csolution: board 'STM32H743I-EVAL:Rev.B' was not found
title: csolution: "board not found" from csolution run -g when an unselected project lists a missing pack
cause: Running a generator creates cbuild-gen files for every project context sharing the build and target type, so packs listed by projects outside the active target set must be installed too. When one is missing the tool reports a misleading board or device error instead of the missing pack.
fix: List the missing packs with csolution list packs <solution> -c *.<build>+<target> -m and install them. The fix passes the active target (-a <target>) when launching the generator so only the selected projects are processed; available from the August 2026 nightly and the matching extension build.

message: error csolution: error occurred during layer detection. Please review the project and its dependencies
title: csolution: Layer detection fails on a multi-core device: processor must be specified
cause: Like board and device names, the processor name (Pname) must be fixed before layers are filtered from packs, even if the layer itself names the core.
fix: Add the processor to the device in the target-type, for example device: NXP::LPC55S69JBD100:cm33_core0.

message: error csolution: file '.../.cmsis/project+target.dbgconf' not found; use --update-rte
title: csolution: Missing .cmsis/*.dbgconf aborts build with an error
cause: csolution convert without RTE update treated a missing dbgconf like a missing component config and failed, although neither the build nor the debug session needs the file (defaults come from debug-vars).
fix: Run once with --update-rte to copy the file. Newer toolbox builds (nightly after 2.12.0) only warn and continue.

message: error csolution: instance does not match regex pattern: (^[A-Za-z\d][\w+()'\/\- \.]+$)|(^([A-Za-z\d][A-Za-z\d ]+::)?
title: csolution: Regex pattern error for a component whose vendor name contains a hyphen
cause: The component-ID schema pattern did not allow a hyphen in the vendor part (for example Arm-Packs:: or MDK-Packs::), so schema validation rejected valid component names.
fix: Fixed after 1.5.0 (devtools PR 777). Workarounds: omit the vendor in the component name or run csolution with --no-check-schema.

message: error csolution: redefinition from 'balanced' into 'none' is not allowed
title: csolution: Redefinition of optimize level from project and solution is rejected
cause: Translation controls such as optimize may only be set once across project, solution, target-type and build-type; redefining them is deliberately an error, regardless of order.
fix: Set optimize: at only one level, for example only in the build-type of the solution.

message: error csolution: required pack: ARM::CMSIS-DSP@1.14.4 not installed, version fixed in *.cbuild-pack.yml file
title: csolution: Packs reported not installed after upgrading to toolbox 2.7.0 (vendor case mismatch)
cause: Version 2.7.0 checked the letter case of pack vendor names strictly. On Windows packs with ARM and Arm vendor spellings share one folder, so some were not found.
fix: Upgrade to 2.8.0 where the strict check was reverted, or stay on 2.6.1 meanwhile.

message: error csolution: required pack: Keil::B-U585I-IOT02A_BSP@2.0.0-dev0 not installed
title: csolution: CubeMX generator run fails with exit code 1 / required pack not installed
cause: The *.cbuild-pack.yml locks the pack version that was current at conversion, while another (dev) version is installed.
fix: Edit the version in cbuild-pack.yml or run with --load latest to use the latest installed packs.

message: error csolution: schema check failed, verify syntax
title: csolution: Schema check failed when compiler: is set to LLVM
cause: The value of compiler: must be one of GCC, CLANG, AC6 or IAR; LLVM is not valid, so the schema check fails at the compiler node.
fix: Use compiler: CLANG for LLVM-based toolchains.

message: error csolution: yaml-cpp: error at line 26, column 9: end of map not found
title: csolution: yaml-cpp error: end of map not found when add-paths is placed next to files
cause: add-paths was indented as a sibling of the file items inside the files sequence, which breaks the YAML structure.
fix: Put add-paths under the individual file entry or at group level, with correct indentation.

message: file '<project>/RTE/Device/<device>/<name>.sct' was not found
title: csolution: Scatter file reported missing right after creating a project from a pack example
cause: The example project is not fully configured: its cproject.yml references the scatter file explicitly under linker:, but the RTE config files are not yet present because the extension does not run update-rte when it loads an existing solution. A reload creates them.
fix: Reload or refresh the solution, which runs update-rte. Lasting fix is in the example: keep the scatter file in the project tree and reference it, instead of relying on the component config file.

message: ninja: error: '<project>/RTE/Device/<device>/ac6_linker_script.sct.srcx', needed by '<out>/CubeMX.axf', missing and no known rule to make it
title: csolution: Misleading ninja error when the linker script named in the project does not exist
cause: csolution did not check linker: script: files, so a typo only surfaced as a ninja error late in the build.
fix: Check the file name under linker: script: in the cproject.yml. Toolbox builds after 2.7.0 report error csolution: file '...' was not found at setup time.

message: warning csolution: yaml schemas were not found, file cannot be validated
title: csolution: error: context was not specified for list dependencies on a solution with several contexts
cause: The solution has several build-type/target-type combinations (contexts), and the command needs exactly one.
fix: Pass -c <project>.<build-type>+<target-type>. The schema warning only means the schema files were not found on that installation.

message: arm-none-eabi-objcopy: c:\Temp\<elfFile> 64-bit address 0x4b4fa300000000 out of range for Intel Hex file
title: other: objcopy 8-2018-q4 on Windows: address out of range for Intel Hex
cause: A bug in the Windows build of the GNU Arm Embedded 8-2018-q4-major toolchain breaks binary to ihex conversion; Mac and Linux builds were fine.
fix: Use an earlier release (7-2018-q2-update or 7-2017-q4-major) or a toolchain build that contains the fix (GNU MCU Eclipse 8.2.1-1.2).

message: packgen error: packchk failed
title: other: packgen: packchk not found although the PackChk binary was copied to the working folder
cause: packgen runs packchk from the PATH; a copy in the current folder is not found, and the executable name is case-sensitive on Linux.
fix: Add the folder containing packchk (for example Utilities/Linux64) to PATH, or run packgen with --nocheck to skip the check.

title: packchk: packchk M371 for unknown device feature type such as LGA
cause: The PDSC schema now accepts any string as device feature type, but packchk still validated against the old fixed enumeration.
fix: Fixed in packchk shipped with toolbox nightlies after 2026-04-07; update the toolbox.

message:
*** ERROR M371: <pack>.pdsc (Line 35)
  Device Feature for 'TestDevice': 'SON' unknown.
title: packchk: ERROR M371 device feature SON unknown
cause: packchk 1.3.95 did not yet contain the SON package feature that PACK.xsd 1.7.7 defines.
fix: Update to packchk 1.3.96 or later.

message:
*** ERROR M371: <pack>.pdsc (Line 761)
  Device Feature for 'STM32U599/5A9': 'MIPI' unknown.
title: packchk: ERROR M371 Device Feature unknown for a feature that PACK.xsd allows (MIPI)
cause: packchk keeps its own hard-coded table of device features that lagged behind the feature list of PACK.xsd.
fix: Use packchk 1.3.98 or later, which knows MIPI.

message: *** WARNING M339: **.pdsc (Line **) Include Path '**' must not be a file!
title: packchk: WARNING M339 says Include Path must not be a file when the directory does not exist
cause: std::filesystem::is_directory also returns false for missing paths, so a non-existing include folder produced the wrong message.
fix: Create or correct the path in the pdsc; packchk 1.3.95 reports the missing path properly.

message:
*** WARNING M379: <pack>.pdsc (Line 52)
  No example(s) found for Board '[STMicroelectronics] B-U585I-IOT02A'.
title: packchk: WARNING M379 No example(s) found for Board
cause: packchk expects a board support pack to ship at least one example for each board.
fix: Add an example, or suppress the message with packchk -x M379.

message: Xerxes reports: element 'processor' is not allowed for content model '(deprecated?,processor*,debugconfig?,
title: packchk: packchk M511: processor element not allowed inside subFamily
cause: The pack schema is order sensitive: processor must come before description in the subFamily body.
fix: Move the processor element to the start of the subFamily; use an XML editor with schema validation. A schema PR to relax the order was opened.

title: pyOCD: Flash programming fails when erased flash reads as 0x00
cause: If PC reads 0 after reset the Thumb bit in xPSR is clear, so running the algorithm faults.
fix: Use a pyOCD that sets the Thumb bit in xPSR before algorithm calls.

title: pyOCD: pyOCD does not use the default CMSIS_PACK_ROOT
cause: pyOCD only read the environment variable and ignored the documented platform default.
fix: Use a newer pyOCD that applies the default, or set CMSIS_PACK_ROOT.

title: pyOCD: Erase device fails on STM32 dual-core boards
cause: The memory region lookup ignored the pname attribute, so it picked the wrong core region.
fix: Use pyOCD 0.40.0 or later.

title: pyOCD: pyOCD load picks the wrong file type for ELF files with an unusual extension such as .out
cause: Without a cbuild-run file pyOCD decides the format from the file extension; IAR produces .out ELF files.
fix: Use pyOCD 0.39.0 or later, which takes the file type from the cbuild-run file; otherwise pass --format elf.

title: pyOCD: CMSIS Load fails with SWD "No ACK" on Infineon T2G after a pyOCD update
cause: pyOCD now does a hardware reset after load. The ResetHardware sequence of the DFP breaks the debug connection, so closing the connection reports an error although programming worked.
fix: Set a different post-load reset in the solution, for example under target-set/debugger: load-setup: post-reset: system. pyOCD 0.45 also copes with this better; the DFP sequence should be corrected.

title: pyOCD: The -O option for the SWV clock seems to be ignored
cause: The option name was misspelled as smv_clock; the real option is swv_clock, and unknown names are silently ignored.
fix: Pass `-O swv_clock=<hz>` with the correct spelling.

title: pyOCD: enable_semihosting option in pyocd.yaml or -O is ignored
cause: The -S/--semihosting command line flag always overrides the initial value of the enable_semihosting option from -O or config, even if the flag is not given.
fix: Pass --semihosting on the pyocd gdbserver command line, or enable it at runtime with monitor arm semihosting enable.

title: pyOCD: gdb memory reads on Cortex-M7 return stale data instead of D-cache contents
cause: pyOCD reads memory through the MEM-AP with default HPROT 0x3, which ignores the CPU data cache. Data in cache not yet cleaned is therefore not visible.
fix: Make AP transfers cacheable: monitor set hprot 0xb after connecting (check with monitor show hprot), for cortex-debug in postAttachCommands. In a user script: def did_connect(): target.aps[0].hprot = 0xb.

title: pyOCD: gdbserver answers an unsupported qXfer request with a malformed '9+' reply
cause: pyOCD only handled target.xml for qXfer feature reads and returned a garbled packet for other files such as arm-m-profile.xml, leaving the client waiting.
fix: Fixed by change #1414; update pyOCD.

title: pyOCD: pyocd list shows target n/a for standalone ST-Link
cause: Automatic target detection only works for on-board probes whose firmware reports the board type; a standalone ST-Link cannot identify the MCU.
fix: Map the probe unique ID to a target in pyocd.yaml under 'probes:' with 'target_override', or pass -t.

title: pyOCD: nRF91 auto-unlock fails with a probe that has no nRESET line
cause: Unlocking this SiP revision requires pin reset from the probe, which a probe offering only SWCLK and SWDIO cannot provide.
fix: Unlock the device and then power cycle it before reconnecting, or use a probe wired to nRST.

title: pyOCD: pyocd load fails on boards without nRESET wired (3-wire SWD) since 0.40
cause: From 0.40.0 the load command always performs a hardware reset via nSRST afterwards, which does nothing useful or breaks SWD when the reset pin is not connected.
fix: Workaround: 'pyocd load --no-reset ...' followed by 'pyocd reset'. The fixed releases add pre-reset and post-reset session options and restore the old default behaviour.

title: pyOCD: pip install pyocd 0.13.0 fails on Linux in setup.py egg_info
cause: Same release mistake as the lowercase-rename problem: the sdist carried a mixed-case package folder, which broke the setuptools_scm based install on Linux.
fix: Use pyOCD 0.13.1 or newer.

title: pyOCD: pyOCD cannot find libusb on Windows: 32-bit Python was installed
cause: The libusb DLL from the 64-bit folder only loads in a 64-bit Python process. The user's Python was 32-bit, so only the 32-bit DLL worked.
fix: Install 64-bit Python (or match the DLL bitness to the interpreter) and place libusb-1.0.dll where Python finds it.

title: pyOCD: Sector-erase flashing of STM32F091 leaves a 1 KB hole in flash
cause: The CMSIS-Pack flash algorithm in the old Keil STM32F0xx DFP declared a 1024-byte sector size while the device uses 2048-byte pages, so the smart flash code programmed only half of each page.
fix: Use Keil.STM32F0xx_DFP 2.1.0 or newer, which corrects the sector size.

title: pyOCD: LPC55S69 is treated as generic cortex_m and flashing fails unless -t is given
cause: The on-board probe runs LPC-Link2 firmware, which is shared by many NXP boards and carries no board ID, so pyOCD cannot detect the target.
fix: Pass `-t lpc55s69`, or flash DAPLink firmware to the probe so the board is auto-detected.

title: pyOCD: i.MX RT1010 EVK is reported as an RT1050 EVK in pyocd list
cause: Early OpenSDA firmware for the RT1010 EVK still carried the RT1050 board ID in the unique ID.
fix: Update the board's debug firmware to a current release.

title: pyOCD: pyocd-gdbserver launched by Cortex-Debug exits at once; GDB reports connection refused
cause: A bug in 0.28.2 made the deprecated pyocd-gdbserver entry point terminate right after start, so the GDB client could not connect.
fix: Upgrade to pyOCD 0.28.3 or later, or use `pyocd gdbserver` instead of the deprecated pyocd-gdbserver command.

message: 0000857:ERROR:__main__:uncaught exception: 0
title: pyOCD: KeyError: 0 on Nucleo with cortex_m target: no AP found, old ST-Link firmware
cause: pyOCD found no CoreSight access port even though the DP ID read worked. The on-board ST-Link firmware was very old (2015 build).
fix: Update the ST-Link firmware, then rerun; the AP and ROM table scan succeeded afterwards.

message: 0000883 W Generic 'cortex_m' target type is selected by default; is this intentional? You will be able to debug most devices, but not program flash.
title: pyOCD: pyocd load with a missing cbuild-run file continues with a generic target and crashes
cause: The cbuild-run file path was wrong, the access error was only logged, and pyOCD went on with a generic Cortex-M target.
fix: Check the path of the --cbuild-run file. From pyOCD 0.39.0 the missing file ends the command instead.

message: 0001184 C Error: <APv1Address@0x1e77c825b50 #2 dp=0> [__main__]
title: pyOCD: Auto-detection fails on NXP K32L3A6 multi-core device
cause: Debug-topology missing from cbuild-run; DFP 19.0.0 listed wrong AP index for the M0+.
fix: Add debug-topology with cm4 apid 0 index 0 and cm0plus apid 1 index 2 to the cbuild-run file, or use a corrected DFP and newer toolbox.

message: 0001855:ERROR:__main__:uncaught exception: STLink error (9): Get IDCODE error
title: pyOCD: Nucleo-L476RG 'STLink error (9): Get IDCODE error' after removing CN2 jumpers
cause: With both CN2 jumpers off, the on-board ST-LINK is routed to the external CN4 header and no longer talks to the on-board STM32 target.
fix: Put the CN2 jumpers back on to program the on-board MCU. Leave them off only to debug an external target through CN4.

message: 0005859:ERROR:gdbserver:Exception while executing remote command 'reset init': unexpected value for reset_type option ('init')
title: pyOCD: Eclipse debug session: 'reset init' rejected by pyocd gdbserver
cause: An outdated Eclipse Embedded CDT pyOCD plugin sends the OpenOCD-style monitor command 'reset init', which pyocd does not accept as a reset type.
fix: Update the Eclipse Embedded CDT plugins to 6.1.1 or later; this removed the error for the reporter.

message: 0007776 E Error while running debug sequence 'ResetSystem' (core cm33_core0): Memory transfer fault [pack_target]
title: pyOCD: monitor reset halt fails on LPC55S69 with CMSIS-Pack debug support
cause: Handling of __errorcontrol and __ap in sequences was wrong; two APs must be declared.
fix: Use pyOCD with the fix and give two accessports (apid 0 index 0, apid 1 index 1) with cm33_core0/cm33_core1.

message: AssertionError
title: pyOCD: gdb load through pyocd-gdbserver ends with AssertionError in progress reporting
cause: A progress-bar assertion introduced in 0.11 when progress reporting was unified could fire near the end of a load; flashing itself was unaffected.
fix: Use pyOCD 0.13.0b2 or later, where the assertion was disabled; 0.10.0 does not have it.

message: Board ID 9904 is not recognised, using generic cortex_m target.
title: pyOCD: micro:bit v2 not recognised and falls back to generic cortex_m target
cause: The micro:bit v2 uses an nRF52833 with a new board ID that older pyOCD releases did not know, and there was no built-in nRF52833 target.
fix: Upgrade pyOCD to 0.31.0 or later, which includes micro:bit v2 and the nRF52833 target.

message: C Control block not found [__main__]
title: pyOCD: RTT: 'Control block not found' although the SEGGER RTT ID is in RAM
cause: pyOCD's RTT search could only find a control block aligned to 16 or 32 bytes.
fix: Compile the firmware with SEGGER_RTT_CB_ALIGN set to 16 or 32; a search fix was merged in change #1730.

message: C Error: Memory regions must have a non-zero length. [__main__]
title: pyOCD: EFR32BG22 pack: 'Memory regions must have a non-zero length'
cause: The Silicon Labs DFP 2025.6.2 contained a faulty memory region definition and a flash loader problem.
fix: Install the DFP version 2025.12.1 or later, which fixes both. Passing -O adi.v5.max_invalid_ap_count=0 helped with non-responsive APs during enumeration.

message: C Memory transfer fault (write) @ 0x20001000-0x2000107f [__main__]
title: pyOCD: Flashing AIR001 fails with Memory transfer fault (write) after 0.36.0
cause: The built-in flash algorithm placed its data buffer at a RAM address that was wrong for the target when double buffering was not in use; this affected many internal targets, not only AIR001.
fix: Upgrade to a release containing change #1898 (generic fix for all internal targets). Workaround was moving the begin_data address in the target file to RAM start plus 0x270.

message: Cannot access memory at address 0xe000ed00
title: pyOCD: gdb cannot read SCB or peripheral registers through pyocd gdbserver
cause: gdb by default restricts memory access to the memory map the server supplies. CMSIS-Pack memory maps normally list only flash and RAM, not device regions such as the peripheral area or PPB, so gdb refuses those reads.
fix: Tell gdb to ignore the supplied map: set mem inaccessible-by-default no. Invalid accesses then simply fault on the target. Alternatively add DeviceRegion entries for Peripheral and PPB in a user script's will_connect.

message: Command "python setup.py egg_info" failed with error code 1
title: pyOCD: pip install pyocd 0.14 fails with pip 18 and old setuptools
cause: The install requirements use environment markers that need a newer setuptools than the one installed (older than about 20.5).
fix: Upgrade setuptools (`pip install -U setuptools`) and retry.

message: ERROR: cmsis-pack-manager 0.4.0 has requirement pyyaml<7.0,>=6.0, but you'll have pyyaml 5.4.1 which is incompatible.
title: pyOCD: pyyaml version conflict between pyocd and cmsis-pack-manager
cause: pyOCD pinned pyyaml below 6.0 while newer cmsis-pack-manager required 6.0.
fix: Upgrade to pyOCD 0.32.1.

message: ERROR:gdbserver:Unhandled exception in handle_message: 'IntervalTree' object has no attribute 'overlap'
title: pyOCD: STM32L4 pack target: gdbserver errors with IntervalTree has no attribute overlap on halt
cause: The Python environment had intervaltree 2.1.0 installed, while pyOCD needs 3.x. A source or editable install does not refresh dependencies after pulling new code. The generic cortex_m target avoided the error only because it has no memory map to cache.
fix: Upgrade intervaltree to 3.0.2 or newer (reinstall pyOCD or `pip install -r dev-requirements.txt`), preferably in a clean Python 3 virtualenv.

message: Erased 32768 bytes (2 sectors), programmed 8192 bytes (2 pages), skipped 57344 bytes (14 pages)
title: pyOCD: fast_program with smart_flash leaves parts of erased sectors blank (silent data loss)
cause: With fast_program and smart_flash, pages whose CRC matched were marked unchanged and the step that forces all pages of a dirty sector to be rewritten was skipped. Sector erase then wiped pages that were never reprogrammed, on devices whose sectors are larger than pages.
fix: Update pyOCD to a release including change #2004. Until then avoid -O fast_program=true together with smart_flash on parts with sector size larger than page size, and verify read-back.

message: Error while running debug sequence 'DebugCoreStop' (core Cortex-M0+): SWD/JTAG communication failure (No ACK) [cbuild_run]
title: pyOCD: load --cbuild-run: post-load hardware reset breaks SWD without ResetHardware sequence
cause: From 0.42.0 the load command defaults the post-reset to a hardware reset when the cbuild-run file has no load-setup section. On devices whose pack lacks a custom ResetHardware sequence, the plain nRESET also resets the debug port and reconnecting fails, even though programming succeeded.
fix: Upgrade to 0.44.1, which reworked post-reset handling. Meanwhile pass '-O load.post_reset=sysresetreq' to pyocd load.

message: Exception ignored in: <function _AutoFinalizedObjectBase.__del__
title: pyOCD: Windows: pyocd list prints usb _objfinalizer exceptions (libusb)
cause: A long-standing pyusb bug showed up after libusb changed its allocation handling; the fix lived in pyusb but was not released for a long time.
fix: Run `pip install -U pyusb` (1.1.0 or newer), or `pip install -U --upgrade-strategy=eager pyocd` to refresh all dependencies.

message: ImportError: No module named pyocd.tools.flash_tool
title: pyOCD: pyocd-flashtool / pyocd-gdbserver ImportError after installing pyOCD 0.13.0
cause: The released 0.13.0 sdist contained the package directory with the wrong letter case, so Python could not import pyocd on case-sensitive or case-aware setups.
fix: Upgrade to pyOCD 0.13.1 or later; temporary workaround was renaming the installed folder to lowercase pyocd.

message: ImportError: cannot import name 'FlashEraser' from 'pyocd.flash.loader'
title: pyOCD: ImportError: cannot import name 'FlashEraser' from 'pyocd.flash.loader' after upgrading
cause: pyOCD 0.24.0 refactored its Python API and moved classes out of pyocd.flash.loader; a third-party tool built on the old API breaks.
fix: Pin the pyOCD version required by the third-party tool (the Python API is unstable before 1.0) or update that tool.

message: IndexError: invalid index
title: pyOCD: J-Link SWO reader thread dies with IndexError: invalid index
cause: The J-Link probe's SWO read passed the byte count straight to pylink, even when no data was available (count 0), which pylink cannot turn into a buffer.
fix: Skip the read when the available byte count is zero. Fixed in pyOCD by a follow-up change; update pyOCD. A monkey patch returning an empty list for a zero count works meanwhile.

message: LookupError: setuptools-scm was unable to detect version for
title: pyOCD: Installing pyOCD from a GitHub source zip fails: setuptools-scm unable to detect version
cause: GitHub's archive downloads lack the git metadata that setuptools_scm uses to derive the version.
fix: Install from PyPI or from a git clone (`pip install git+https://github.com/...`); the problem was avoided for release zips from 0.12.0.

message: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pyocd._version
title: pyOCD: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'pyocd._version' when installed from source
cause: pyocd._version is generated by setuptools_scm at build time, which setup.py does not install by itself.
fix: Install with 'pip install .' or install setuptools_scm[toml] first.

message: No available debug probes are connected
title: pyOCD: ST-Link no longer listed on Windows 7 after an ST-Link firmware upgrade
cause: The firmware upgrade removed the libusb driver association for the ST-Link on Windows 7; its WinUSB driver mode is only available from Windows 8 on, so libusb found nothing.
fix: Use Zadig to assign the libusb-win32 driver to the ST-Link debug interface.

message: No available debug probes are connected
title: pyOCD: pyocd list shows no probe with Python 3.12 and 0.36.0 on Windows
cause: libusb-package had no wheel for Python 3.12, so pip tried to build it and, without Visual Studio, installed it without libusb-1.0.dll.
fix: Place libusb-1.0.dll (from the libusb releases) in a location on the search path such as C:\Windows\System32, or use a Python/libusb-package combination that has a wheel.

message: No available debug probes are connected
title: pyOCD: CMSIS-DAP probe with a plain product name (AK-CMSIS-DAP) is not detected
cause: pyOCD's pyusb backend required 'CMSIS-DAP' in the USB interface string, which is only mandatory for composite devices.
fix: Upgrade to pyOCD 0.25.0 or newer, which relaxes the interface name requirement.

message: ProbeError: J-Link is already open
title: pyOCD: Scanning probes raises 'J-Link is already open' when another tool uses a J-Link
cause: The J-Link probe class opened every probe during enumeration and let the error propagate if another application held it.
fix: Fixed in pyOCD 0.28.3. Meanwhile prefix the probe UID with the plugin name, e.g. `--probe=cmsisdap:<uid>`, to restrict probing.

message: RuntimeError: attempt to modify read-only variable 'DHCSR_Addr'
title: pyOCD: Pack defines DHCSR_Addr in <debugvars>: 'attempt to modify read-only variable'
cause: Variables declared in a pack's global debugvars are read-only. From 0.44.0 the default debug sequences (such as DebugCoreStart) are used when a pack lacks its own, and they declared locals with the same names, which clashed with the pack's global.
fix: Upgrade to 0.44.1, where the locals in the default sequences carry a '__' prefix. Alternatively avoid reusing the register-address variable names as global debugvars.

message: STLink error (20): DP wait
title: pyOCD: STM32L4S5 'DP wait' or invalid CoreSight IDs when firmware uses deep sleep
cause: The firmware enters a low-power mode (Mbed sleep_for puts the MCU into Stop2). Recent STM32 parts need the DBGMCU_CR debug bits set to wake the debug domain before discovery, so ROM table reads return invalid IDs and the probe reports errors.
fix: Put a pyocd_user.py in the working directory (or pass --script) whose will_init_target hook inserts a step after dp_init that writes DBGMCU_CR (0xE0042004 on L4) via AP0 CSW/TAR/DRW writes with value 0x00700007. Confirmed to fix debugging in pyocd and Mbed Studio. Alternatively avoid sleep in debug builds (use wait_us instead of sleep_for). Built-in handling was planned via CMSIS-Pack debug sequences.

message: Target type 'stm32l4a6vg' not recognized.
title: pyOCD: pack --install with a short STM32L4 name installs a pack that has no such device
cause: Newer versions of the vendor pack renamed devices to include package suffixes (for example stm32l4a6vgtx), and pyOCD always uses only the newest pack version in the index, so the old short name no longer matches.
fix: Search with `pyocd pack --find <part>` and install or select the full device name including the suffix, e.g. `pyocd pack --install stm32l4a6vgtx`.

message: TypeError: object of type 'NoneType' has no len()
title: pyOCD: Semihosting read of zero bytes crashes the gdbserver with TypeError
cause: The semihosting console read computed the result from the data length before checking that any data was returned.
fix: Fixed in change #1811; update pyOCD.

message: ValueError: Attempted relative import in non-package
title: pyOCD: Debugging pyocd __main__.py from an IDE: 'Attempted relative import in non-package'
cause: The IDE runs pyocd/__main__.py as a plain script, so Python does not treat it as part of the pyocd package.
fix: Run it as a module (`python -m pyocd`) in a virtualenv with pyocd installed; in the IDE configure a module run target named pyocd instead of a script path.

message: ValueError: attempted relative import beyond top-level package
title: pyOCD: Running tools/pyocd.py from a build tree: 'relative import beyond top-level package'
cause: The scripts under pyocd/tools are deprecated modules and not entry points; running them directly from a build tree breaks their relative imports.
fix: Run the installed `pyocd` executable or `python -m pyocd`. For development, install into a virtualenv with `pip install -e .` instead of `setup.py install`.

message: W No matching devices
title: pyOCD: pyocd pack install with a name prefix finds no devices on Python 3.14
cause: A change in how prefix matching worked broke under Python 3.14; the same command works on Python 3.13 and a full part name always works.
fix: Use Python 3.13 or earlier, install the full part number, or upgrade to a pyOCD release containing change #1993.

message: W No matching devices. Please make sure the pack index is up to date. [pack_cmd]
title: pyOCD: pyocd pack install finds no devices; pack update produces XML warnings
cause: Updating the index with many concurrent requests triggered server protection at Keil and NXP, leaving corrupted descriptors.
fix: Upgrade cmsis-pack-manager to 0.5.2 or later and run 'pyocd pack update --clean'. Some remaining download errors for broken vendor entries are normal.

message: W had to forcibly halt core after reset [target_lpc5500]
title: pyOCD: LPC54 devices use the LPC55 unlock sequence and cannot reset and halt
cause: The LPC5500 family regular expression also matched LPC54xx parts, so the LPC55 debug-mailbox unlock sequence ran on a chip that has no such access port.
fix: Fixed by change #1440; upgrade.

message: WARNING:file_programmer:Failed to add data chunk: no memory region defined for address 0x08000000
title: pyOCD: Flashing with '-t cortex_m' programs 0 bytes: no memory region defined
cause: The generic cortex_m target has no memory map or flash algorithm, so there is nowhere to program.
fix: Select the real device with -t, using a name from the pack given in the config (`pyocd list --targets --config <cfg> --name <part>`).

message: WARNING:loader:No operation performed
title: pyOCD: pyocd erase does nothing and prints 'No operation performed'
cause: Without positional addresses, erase intentionally does nothing unless --chip or --mass-erase is given.
fix: Run `pyocd erase --chip` (or --mass-erase), or give sector addresses.

message: flash erase sector failure (address 0x00000000; result code 0x67)
title: pyOCD: flash erase sector failure (result code 0x67) on micro:bit V2
cause: The micro:bit uses a Nordic SoftDevice, which locks its flash sectors once installed, so the normal erase refuses.
fix: Run a mass erase (pyocd erase --mass -t nrf52833) once, then flash normally. Chip erase leaves the SoftDevice in place.

message: link exception during target disconnect: Memory transfer fault @ 0xe000edf0-0xe000edf3
title: pyOCD: LPC55 factory-new chip: erase/flash fails after reset with memory transfer fault
cause: A new LPC55 starts with debug access locked; pyOCD unlocks it on connect but the reset done before flashing locks it again and the unlock was not repeated.
fix: Fixed in v0.33.0: the unlock is re-run after reset.

message: module 'hid' has no attribute 'device'
title: pyOCD: pyocd warns that module 'hid' has no attribute 'device'
cause: The wrong Python package providing the 'hid' module was installed by hand (pyhidapi instead of the Cython hidapi binding that pyOCD expects).
fix: Remove the wrong package and let pip install pyOCD's own dependencies; the correct one is the PyPI package named 'hidapi' (cython-hidapi).

message: pyocd.core.exceptions.ProbeError: Probe 0123456789 read thread exited unexpectedly
title: pyOCD: CMSIS-DAP bulk SWO: 'read thread exited unexpectedly'
cause: A flag marking the SWO thread as finished stayed set when the USB interface was closed and reused, so the reader reported failure although the thread was running.
fix: Fixed by changes #1755 and #1824; update pyOCD.

message: pyocd.core.exceptions.TargetSupportError: RP2040 requires a debug probe with SWD sequence capability
title: pyOCD: RP2040 over DAPLink probe: requires a probe with SWD sequence capability
cause: RP2040 needs CMSIS-DAP commands added in protocol version 1.2.0; the probe runs older DAPLink firmware.
fix: Update the probe's DAPLink firmware to release 0254 or later.

message: uncaught exception: 'kl27z'
title: pyOCD: gdbserver crashes with KeyError 'kl27z' for a FRDM-KL27Z without -t
cause: The board table named the target kl27z while the target registry used kl27z4, so the automatic lookup failed.
fix: Pass `-t kl27z4` or use a pyOCD version with the corrected board table (fix #307).

message: uncaught exception: cannot import name 'ENODATA' from 'errno' (unknown location)
title: pyOCD: pyocd flash on FreeBSD fails with ImportError for ENODATA from errno
cause: pyusb referenced an errno constant that exists only on Linux, so the USB backend failed on FreeBSD when opening a CMSIS-DAP probe.
fix: Use pyusb 1.2.1 or newer, which contains the fix; pyOCD raised its minimum pyusb requirement accordingly.

message: warning: while parsing target memory map (at line 3): Required element <memory> is missing
title: pyOCD: gdb 'load' fails and warns about missing <memory> element: target is the generic cortex_m
cause: No target type was set, so pyOCD used the generic cortex_m target. It provides no memory map and no flash algorithm, hence gdb complains and cannot load. STLink probes were not auto-detected at that time.
fix: Obtain the device pack (or use a release with pack support), then start with `--pack <file> -t <device>`, for example `pyocd gdbserver --pack <Keil.STM32F1xx_DFP>.pack -t stm32f103ze`. The pack subcommand only exists from 0.20.0.

title: svdconv: svdconv --generate partition loops endlessly when the SVD has no sauNumRegions
cause: Without sauNumRegions the internal default (an unset marker, all bits set) was used as region count, so the generated partition header ran SAU_INIT_REGION far beyond any sensible number.
fix: Fixed in SVDConv 3.3.46: the count is checked and the header contains an #error that the number of SAU regions is not set. Add sauNumRegions under cpu in the SVD.

title: svdconv: SVDConv 3.3.46 reports error M364 for sauNumRegions equal to 0
cause: A value of 0 is valid by the SVD schema, but the new check rejected it.
fix: Fixed in SVDConv 3.3.47, which compares sauNumRegions with the configured SAU regions: warning M391 when regions exceed the number, error M387 when it is 0 but regions exist.

title: svdconv: Header type name uses peripheral name (WDT0_Type) instead of groupName
cause: SVDConv names the struct after the peripheral name unless told otherwise; groupName is not used for this.
fix: Add <headerStructName>WDT</headerStructName> to the peripheral, then all peripherals of the group share the WDT_Type struct.

title: svdconv: svdconv --generate=sfr does nothing on Linux or macOS
cause: The SFR output needs the Windows-only SfrCC2 tool from Keil MDK; svdconv silently skipped it elsewhere.
fix: Generate SFR files on Windows only. svdconv 3.3.51 now reports an error with exit code 2 on other systems; SFD generation works everywhere.

title: svdconv: svdconv writes __VTOR_PRESENT 0 when vtorPresent is missing in the SVD
cause: The SVD specification says a missing vtorPresent means VTOR is present, but svdconv assumed false.
fix: Use svdconv 3.3.51 or later, or set vtorPresent explicitly in the SVD.
